title: Telemarketing Sales Agent (Remote| Full-Time)
description:
Join Our Fast-Growing Sales Team!



We are looking for highly motivated, results-driven Telemarketing Sales Agents to join our growing remote team.



If you enjoy talking to people, closing sales, and earning based on your performance, this opportunity offers unlimited earning potential.



This role focuses on reaching potential customers through
 and other social media platforms, engaging them in conversations, and converting interested prospects into completed sales.



---



COMPENSATION



Training & Probationary Period (First Month)



This is a commission-based position during your first month.



* Earn ?20–?50 for every successful closed sale.

* Unlimited earning potential.

* Maximum commission payout of ?5,000 per day.



Top performers can significantly increase their daily earnings through consistent sales performance.



---



REGULAR EMPLOYMENT



After successfully completing the probationary period and meeting performance expectations, you will become a regular member of our team.



Regular employees receive:

* ?1,000 daily base pay.

* ?10–?25 commission per successful sale.

* Continued opportunities for performance incentives and career growth.



---



DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES



* Reach out to potential customers using
 and other approved social media platforms.

* Build rapport and establish trust with prospects.

* Present products and answer customer questions.

* Guide interested customers through the ordering process.

* Record interactions and sales accurately.

* Meet daily activity and performance goals.



---



DAILY PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Activity Target:

Reach out to approximately 100 prospective customers per day.



Performance Target:

* Average 2 successful sales per working hour.

* Approximately 16 successful sales during an 8-hour shift.



These targets help determine readiness for regular employment and long-term success with the company.



---



QUALIFICATIONS



We're looking for people who are:

* Excellent communicators.

* Confident speaking with new people.

* Friendly and persuasive.

* Sales-oriented.

* Self-motivated.

* Goal-driven.

* Comfortable working remotely.

* Reliable with attendance.

* Willing to learn and accept coaching.



Experience in telemarketing, appointment setting, outbound sales, customer service, or online selling is an advantage but not required if you have the right attitude and willingness to learn.



---



EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS



Applicants must have:

* Desktop or laptop computer

* Stable internet connection

* Quality headset with microphone

* Quiet working environment



---



WHY JOIN US?

* Unlimited commission opportunities

* Fast career growth for high performers

* Work-from-home setup

* Performance-based advancement

* Supportive coaching and training

* Join a growing international sales team



---



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



To apply, please submit the following:

1. Your updated resume.

2. A brief summary of your sales or customer service experience.

3. Your expected start date.



Only applicants who complete all application requirements will be considered for an interview.

title: Executive Property Manager
description:
Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Salary: Competitive – Based on Experience



About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Executive Property Manager to lead our remote property management team and oversee the day-to-day operations of a growing residential property portfolio. This leadership role is responsible for ensuring operational excellence, delivering exceptional service to property owners and residents, driving team performance, and continuously improving processes.

The ideal candidate is a strategic leader with extensive property management experience, excellent communication skills, and a proven ability to manage remote teams in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Management

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Team Leads, Virtual Property Managers, Vendor Coordinators, and Administrative staff.

Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, coaching sessions, and performance reviews.

Establish team goals, monitor KPIs, and drive continuous improvement.

Manage staffing, workload distribution, scheduling, and resource planning.

Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and exceptional customer service.

Property Management Operations

Oversee the daily operations of residential, commercial, and HOA property portfolios.

Ensure timely processing of maintenance requests, work orders, and vendor coordination.

Supervise lease administration, renewals, move-ins, move-outs, and tenant communications.

Monitor rent collection, delinquency follow-up, and lease compliance.

Review owner reports, operational reports, and portfolio performance.

Ensure compliance with company policies, fair housing regulations, and property management best practices.

Resolve complex tenant, owner, and vendor escalations.

Process Improvement

Develop and implement operational procedures and best practices.

Identify workflow inefficiencies and implement solutions to improve productivity.

Drive automation and technology adoption where appropriate.

Monitor quality assurance and ensure consistency across all portfolios.

Collaboration

Work closely with Accounting, Maintenance, and Executive Leadership teams.

Support new client onboarding and property transitions.

Participate in strategic planning and operational initiatives.

Prepare management reports and present operational updates to leadership.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Property Management, Real Estate, or a related field (preferred).

Minimum 5 years of experience in property management, including Homeowners Associations (HOAs), commercial, and residential properties.

At least 3 years of management or leadership experience.

Experience leading remote teams.

Strong understanding of property management operations and industry best practices.

Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.

Preferred Experience

Experience using property management platforms such as Buildium, AppFolio, Propertyware, Rent Manager, or Yardi.

Experience managing portfolios of multiple residential properties.

Familiarity with maintenance coordination, leasing, owner reporting, and vendor management.

Experience implementing SOPs, KPIs, and operational performance metrics.

Required Skills

Leadership and people management

Property management operations

Strategic planning

Process improvement

Performance management

Tenant and owner relations

Vendor management

Lease administration

Financial and operational reporting

Conflict resolution

Project management

Time management

Excellent written and verbal English communication

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Team productivity and service quality

Response and resolution times

Maintenance completion timelines

Lease renewal and occupancy performance

Rent collection and delinquency management

Customer satisfaction (owners and residents)

Compliance with SOPs and company standards

Employee engagement and retention

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back

title: GoHighLevel Specialist
description:
ABOUT HARMONY MARKETING



Harmony Marketing is a US-based digital marketing agency helping high-ticket service businesses generate better leads and turn them into customers.



We create video-powered sales funnels that combine Meta advertising, landing pages, GoHighLevel CRM systems, and automated follow-up. GoHighLevel is the backbone of how we onboard clients, manage leads, automate communication, and support our campaigns.



We are looking for an experienced GoHighLevel Specialist to take ownership of the platform across our client accounts.



This is not an entry-level position. We are not looking for someone who is simply familiar with GoHighLevel or still learning the platform. We need someone who understands how the system works, can identify problems quickly, and knows how to build clean, reliable solutions.



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



• Build, configure, and manage client sub-accounts using our established templates and snapshots



• Complete the technical account setup for newly onboarded clients



• Build, test, monitor, and troubleshoot workflows and automations



• Manage pipelines, calendars, forms, communication workflows, and account settings



• Handle A2P registration, phone-number setup, transfers, and compliance requirements



• Build and troubleshoot integrations using APIs, webhooks, Make, Zapier, or similar tools



• Audit existing accounts for errors, broken workflows, missed opportunities, and inconsistent configurations



• Maintain quality and consistency across client sub-accounts



• Diagnose technical issues and clearly communicate solutions to our internal team



• Support team members with GoHighLevel questions and platform-related needs



• Document processes and maintain clear internal SOPs



• Proactively recommend improvements that make our systems more reliable, scalable, and efficient



This is an internal technical role. You will not be responsible for communicating directly with clients.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• Advanced, hands-on GoHighLevel experience



• Experience working inside an agency account with multiple client sub-accounts



• Strong workflow and automation-building skills



• Experience with A2P registration, phone-number management, and messaging compliance



• Working knowledge of APIs, webhooks, Make, Zapier, and third-party integrations



• Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to identify the root cause of an issue



• Experience auditing accounts and maintaining quality across multiple builds



• Highly organized and able to manage several priorities without losing attention to detail



• Proactive, dependable, and communicative with the internal team—you ask questions, provide updates, and do not go silent



• Comfortable supporting both technical and nontechnical team members



• Comfortable using AI tools as part of your daily workflow



• Available for consistent partial overlap with US Central Time business hours



• Strong written and spoken English



BONUS QUALIFICATIONS



• Experience working with US-based marketing agencies



• Experience building funnels or websites inside GoHighLevel



• Experience with GoHighLevel’s AI tools



• Familiarity with Meta lead-generation campaigns and automated lead follow-up



• Experience creating technical documentation and SOPs



• Experience improving or standardizing systems across a large number of sub-accounts



POSITION DETAILS



This is a part-time contractor position with the opportunity to transition into a full-time role if it is a strong mutual fit.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted part of the Harmony Marketing team, take genuine ownership of GoHighLevel, and grow with us. You will be expected to communicate reliably, manage your workload, and remain available during agreed-upon hours that partially overlap with US Central Time.



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application using exactly seven numbered points.



Your seven points should tell us:



1. How long you have worked with GoHighLevel

2. The types of agency accounts and sub-accounts you have managed

3. Examples of workflows, automations, or systems you have personally built

4. Your experience with A2P registration and phone-number management

5. Your experience with APIs, webhooks, Make, Zapier, or other integrations

6. A difficult GoHighLevel problem you diagnosed and how you solved it

7. Your availability and the hours you can overlap with US Central Time



Be specific. We want to understand what you personally built, managed, repaired, and improved. Vague, generic, or copied applications will not be considered.

title: Canva Graphic Designer | Luxury Events & Weddings (Part-Time ? Full-Time)
description:
Part-Time | Work From Home | Opportunity to Grow Full-Time



? Create designs that people fall in love with.



Imagine creating beautiful concepts that help couples picture their dream wedding.



Imagine designing presentations that win exciting new projects for big brands.



Imagine seeing your work become part of unforgettable celebrations.



That's exactly what you'll be doing!



We're looking for a creative designer with a great eye for detail and a passion for beautiful design to join our growing creative team.



This isn't just another Canva job where you'll spend your day creating social media posts.



Instead, you'll help transform ideas into premium visual concepts for luxury weddings, corporate events and bespoke celebrations.



Every project is different.



Every design you create has a purpose.



If you genuinely love creating beautiful work and get satisfaction from making designs look their absolute best, we'd love to hear from you.



??????????????????????????????

WHO WE ARE

??????????????????????????????



We are a Sydney-based premium event design studio creating unforgettable weddings, corporate events and bespoke celebrations throughout Australia.



Our clients come to us because they want more than beautiful styling.



They want an experience.



Every proposal we create is carefully designed to help our clients visualise their event before it even happens.



We're proud of the work we produce and we're looking for someone who shares that same passion for creativity and attention to detail.



??????????????????????????????

YOUR ROLE

??????????????????????????????



You'll become an important part of our creative team, working closely with our Creative Director and Proposal & Operations Coordinator to bring our clients' visions to life.



Every project begins with a client consultation, where we uncover the client's style, vision and requirements. From there, our team prepares a detailed design brief and proposal, giving you everything you need to start creating.



Working from that brief and our professionally designed Canva template library you'll customise each presentation to reflect the client's unique vision.



You'll create polished, presentation-ready concepts by thoughtfully incorporating furniture, florals, styling elements, décor, colour palettes and layouts that feel cohesive, elegant and inspiring.



Your designs will help clients visualise their event before it even happens, making them an essential part of the client experience.



Many of the concepts you create will become real weddings, corporate events and celebrations. There's something incredibly rewarding about seeing an idea you've helped design come to life.



While we have templates, design systems and clear creative direction, we're not looking for someone who simply follows instructions.



We're looking for someone who naturally thinks...



"This would look even better if I changed this."



Someone who notices the little details.



Someone who takes initiative.



Someone who genuinely enjoys making good designs even better.



You'll always have the support and guidance of our team, but we also want someone who enjoys contributing ideas, refining concepts and taking pride in producing work that exceeds expectations.



If you enjoy collaborating, thinking creatively and creating designs that genuinely excite people, you'll fit right in.



??????????????????????????????

HOW YOU'LL WORK WITH US

??????????????????????????????



Every project follows a simple creative process:



???? Client Discovery

Our Creative Director meets with the client to understand their vision, style and requirements.



???? Creative Brief

Our Proposal & Operations Coordinator prepares the project brief, proposal and supporting information.



???? Design & Mock-Ups

You'll bring the vision to life by creating beautiful Canva concepts that help clients visualise their event.



? Refinement

Together, we'll review and refine the concepts before they're presented to the client.



??????????????????????????????

WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING

??????????????????????????????



? Luxury wedding concepts



? Corporate event presentations



? Event styling mock-ups



? Mood boards



? Client proposal presentations



? Event stationery concepts



? Custom Canva layouts



? Social media graphics (Instagram,
 & LinkedIn) as the role grows



No two projects are ever the same.



One day you might be designing a luxury wedding reception.



The next, a corporate product launch.



Then perhaps a completely new creative concept for an upcoming proposal.



??????????????????????????????

YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE IF YOU...

??????????????????????????????



? Love using Canva



? Have an exceptional eye for design and composition



? Notice details that other people often miss



? Enjoy creating elegant, modern and premium designs



? Work efficiently without compromising quality



? Take initiative instead of waiting for instructions



? Are organised and meet deadlines



? Enjoy learning and improving your skills



? Want to be part of a creative team - not simply complete tasks



Experience in weddings, events, interiors, styling or luxury brands is highly regarded—but certainly not essential.



??????????????????????????????

WHAT WE OFFER

??????????????????????????????



? Flexible remote working



? Approximately 3 days per week



? Opportunity to grow into a full-time role



? Work on exciting luxury projects



? Every project is different



? A supportive and collaborative creative team



? Opportunities to expand into branding, marketing and social media



? A workplace where creativity and initiative are genuinely valued



We're looking for someone who wants to grow with us long-term and become an important part of our creative journey.



??????????????????????????????

HOW TO APPLY

??????????????????????????????



We'd love to learn more about you.



Please include the following with your application:



???? A link to your Canva portfolio or examples of your work



???? A short introduction about yourself



?? Approximately how long it would take you to customise an existing Canva template into a polished client presentation



???? Your computer specifications



???? Your internet speed



? Begin your application with the word Sparkle so we know you've read the entire advertisement.



??????????????????????????????

BONUS CHALLENGE (Highly Regarded)

??????????????????????????????



Want to stand out?



Choose a luxury wedding or event inspiration image from Pinterest and recreate the overall look and feel in Canva using your own creativity.



Send us either the Canva link or a PDF.



We'd love to see how you think as a designer.



??????????????????????????????

A FINAL NOTE...

??????????????????????????????



We're not looking for someone to simply edit templates.



We're looking for someone who takes pride in creating beautiful work.



Someone who enjoys solving creative problems.



Someone who gets excited about bringing ideas to life.



If you care about quality, love thoughtful design, and want to grow with a business that genuinely values creativity, we'd love to meet you.

title: Product Lister SHOPIFY
description:
# Shopify Product Lister & AI Content Assistant



We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented **Shopify Product Lister** who can help us upload, structure, optimize, and improve products across multiple e-commerce stores.



This is not just a basic copy-and-paste role. You must understand how a professional Shopify product page should be structured and be able to use AI tools efficiently to create high-quality content and visuals.



## Main Responsibilities



* Upload and publish products in Shopify

* Create clear and professional product titles

* Write and format product descriptions

* Add product images, variants, prices, SKUs, tags, and collections

* Structure product pages correctly

* Check spelling, formatting, image quality, and mobile appearance

* Use ChatGPT to improve product descriptions, benefits, headlines, FAQs, and other content

* Use Higgsfield to create or improve product-related visuals and creative content

* Follow our instructions and existing store formats accurately

* Make sure every product page is complete before publishing

* Identify missing information or mistakes instead of blindly uploading content

* Work efficiently with multiple products and stores



## Requirements



* At least **1 year of experience** working with Shopify product listings

* Proven experience uploading and optimizing Shopify products

* Strong attention to detail

* Good written English

* Experience working with **ChatGPT**

* Experience working with **Higgsfield**

* Comfortable using AI tools as part of your daily workflow

* Able to follow detailed instructions and templates

* Able to work independently and meet deadlines

* Good understanding of e-commerce product pages and conversion-focused content

* Reliable communication and availability



Experience with image editing, Canva, Shopify page builders, product research, advertorials, or dropshipping stores is a bonus.



## Important Application Instructions



To show that you have read the complete job description, your application title must start with:



**PLISTER**



Applications without **PLISTER** in the title will not be considered.



In your application, briefly mention:



1. How many years of Shopify experience you have

2. Your experience with ChatGPT

3. Your experience with Higgsfield

4. One or two Shopify stores or product-listing examples you have worked on

5. Your availability and preferred hourly rate



At the end of your application, write a **short paragraph about your hobbies and what you enjoy doing outside of work**.



Keep your work introduction brief. We are more interested in seeing that you followed the instructions, have real experience, and can communicate clearly.



We are looking for someone who can potentially work with us long term. Accuracy, speed, communication, and the ability to use AI effectively are very important.

title: Government Contracts & Grants Proposal Specialist
description:
The Government Contracts & Grants Proposal Specialist is responsible for identifying, evaluating, and pursuing government funding opportunities through contracts, grants, and cooperative agreements. This role researches federal, state, and local procurement opportunities, coordinates proposal development, writes compelling and compliant submissions, and collaborates with internal stakeholders to secure funding that supports organizational growth and strategic initiatives.



Key Responsibilities

Research and identify government contract, grant, and funding opportunities from federal, state, and local agencies.

Monitor procurement portals, grant databases, and bid notification systems for new opportunities.

Analyze solicitations, Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Quotes (RFQs), Invitations for Bids (IFBs), and Notices of Funding Opportunities (NOFOs) to determine eligibility and competitiveness.

Lead the development, writing, editing, and submission of grant applications and government contract proposals.

Develop proposal narratives, technical responses, budgets, schedules, and required supporting documentation.

Coordinate with subject matter experts, finance, operations, and leadership to gather proposal content and ensure compliance with solicitation requirements.

Ensure all submissions meet agency guidelines, deadlines, formatting requirements, and compliance standards.

Maintain a proposal calendar and manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.

Build and maintain a library of proposal templates, resumes, past performance documentation, and organizational capabilities.

Track proposal outcomes, contract awards, and grant reporting requirements.

Develop relationships with government agencies, procurement officials, and strategic partners.

Stay informed of changes in government procurement regulations, grant policies, and funding trends.

Assist with contract negotiations, modifications, and post-award documentation as needed.

Required Qualifications

Ability to learn.  Opportunity to move to full time if successful in role. Preferred Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Communications, English, Nonprofit Management, or a related field (or equivalent experience).  Willing to teach and work with a great candidate.

Experience or strong desire to learn government contracting, grant writing, proposal development, or business development.

Strong project management and organizational skills.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and proposal management tools.

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of government procurement platforms such as SAM.gov, Grants.gov, or state procurement portals.





Key Competencies

Proposal and grant writing

Government contracting knowledge

Research and opportunity analysis

Compliance management

Budget development

Strategic planning

Attention to detail

Communication and collaboration

Time management

Critical thinking and problem-solving

Performance Measures

Number and quality of proposals submitted.

Proposal submission accuracy and compliance.

Grant and contract win rate.

Total funding or contract dollars awarded.

On-time completion of proposal milestones.

Stakeholder satisfaction and cross-functional collaboration.



This position is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who combines strong research and persuasive writing skills with the ability to navigate complex government procurement and grant processes to help an organization secure new funding opportunities. title: Operations & Customer Success Assistant - TikTok Shop Brand Deal Platform
description:
About Us:

CLOSR is an AI platform that manages brand collaboration inboxes for TikTok Shop creators. When a brand
s a creator about a paid partnership, our system reads it, negotiates the rate, and closes the deal automatically. We've closed 893 deals with 472 brands and over $500,000 in creator revenue. Small team, growing fast.



The Role:

Two halves. Running our daily deal pipeline audit, finding deals that have stalled and getting them moving, errors in classification. The rest of your time you own creator relationships, making sure our users are actually getting results and stepping in before they churn.



Daily audit:

- Review deals flagged as needing a reply and take the right action; whether that means leaving it as is, re-classifying, or anything else

- Audit pending deals where terms were sent but nothing came back or brands have concerns

- Check platform health and flag anything broken to the founder

- Review closed deals for errors in compensation, deliverables, or terms

- Spot patterns or inefficiencies that could be improved on



Customer Success:

- Onboard new creators and make sure they're fully set up and closing within their first two weeks

- Monitor account health and proactively reach out to creators whose results are slipping

- Run check-ins with creators to understand what's working and what isn't, enforcing usage

- Collect and organize product feedback, and flag recurring issues to the founder



You'd be great if you:

- Have worked as a VA in the TikTok Shop or creator economy space

- Have managed a creator's inbox, brand outreach, or affiliate campaigns before

- Can read an
 negotiation and tell when something's off

- Are comfortable reaching out to customers proactively rather than waiting for tickets

- Are detail-obsessed. This role is about noticing things other people miss.

- Communicate clearly and warmly in written English

- Can work independently and escalate when unsure



Nice to have:

- Familiarity with TikTok Shop, content, brand deal structures, communicating with CPG brands/agencies

• Demonstrable experience increasing organic traffic, qualified leads and revenue.

• Advanced knowledge of keyword research, search intent, content strategy and on-page SEO.

• Experience with digital PR, backlink analysis and authority building.

• Strong analytical and reporting skills.

• Experience using tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Sitebulb, GA4 and Google Search Console.

• Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to produce, review and optimise high-quality content for UK audiences.

• Strong communication and project-management skills, with the ability to present SEO performance and recommendations clearly to international stakeholders.

• Ability to work independently and take accountability for results.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders based across different locations and time zones.



Desirable Experience

title: Senior Manual QA Engineer (Web and Mobile)
description:
Senior Manual QA Engineer (Web and Mobile)

Type: Full-time, remote

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 4:00 AM – 1:00 PM EST 

Compensation: $1,500/month



About the Role:

We're looking for an experienced manual QA tester to own quality across our consumer web and mobile products. Quality remains shared by Product and Engineering; QA should expose risk, not become the release safety net. — designing your own coverage, hunting down the issues automation misses, and giving Product and Engineering a clear read on release risk.

This role suits someone who works independently, thinks in terms of real customer journeys rather than checklists alone, and writes bug reports so precise that no one has to ask a follow-up question.



What you'll do:

Turn product requirements, designs, and acceptance criteria into practical, risk-based test plans and checklists.

Perform functional, smoke, regression, exploratory, integration, and release testing across supported browsers, screen sizes, and iOS/Android devices.

Validate critical customer journeys in development, preview, staging, and production environments as appropriate.

Test happy paths, edge cases, interruptions, permissions, uploads, navigation, slow or unreliable connections, and state persistence.

Check cross-platform consistency, responsive layouts, copy, loading/empty/error states, accessibility basics, and overall usability.

File high-signal bug reports with the environment and build, device/browser details, preconditions, exact reproduction steps, expected versus actual behavior, severity, and screenshots or video.

Re-test fixes, run focused regression around changed areas, and keep issue status accurate through release.

Work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to clarify requirements, surface release risk, and make clear ship/no-ship recommendations.

Maintain reusable regression suites, test data, device/browser coverage, and QA documentation.

Improve the QA process by identifying recurring failure patterns and gaps in coverage.



Requirements:

5+ years of hands-on manual QA experience testing consumer web and mobile products.

Demonstrated experience testing on both iOS and Android, plus responsive desktop and mobile browsers.

Strong command of test-case design, exploratory testing, regression testing, defect triage, and release validation.

Ability to turn incomplete or ambiguous requirements into organized test coverage without waiting for step-by-step instructions.

Excellent bug-reporting skills: another person can reproduce the issue from your ticket without a follow-up meeting.

Strong attention to detail across functionality, visual presentation, copy, state changes, and platform-specific behavior.

Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle and basic client/server and HTTP concepts.

Clear written and verbal English communication.

Reliable, organized, and comfortable managing several features or releases in a fast-moving remote environment.

Customer empathy and sound judgment about severity, business impact, and release risk.

State that Machines and personal devices are a requirement



Nice to have:

Experience with consumer subscription, marketplace, social, or dating products.

Comfort using browser developer tools, API-testing tools, logs, or basic read-only database queries to narrow down failures.

Familiarity with Linear, Slack, GitHub preview builds, or similar product-development workflows.

Knowledge of mobile accessibility and common iOS/Android platform conventions.

Exposure to automated testing and the judgment to identify cases worth automating, while remaining focused on manual QA.



How to apply:

Send your résumé to us along with a short note on the products you've tested, the devices and browsers you cover, and one bug you're proud of catching, what it was, how you found it, and why it mattered.

title: Software QA Engineer
description:
Software QA Engineer / Tester (100% Remote)

1. Location: Anywhere in the Philippines (Cebu, Mindanao, and regional applicants highly encouraged)

2. Work Setup: 100% Work-From-Home (Remote)

3. Schedule: Monday to Friday, Standard Singapore Business Hours (GMT+8)

4. Competitive Salary: ?60,000 – ?95,000 PHP per month, depending on experience

5. About the Role:

We are seeking a proactive Software QA Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability and performance of our web, mobile and backend systems. This role involves end-to-end software testing, defect management, API and database validation, and close collaboration with developers and project teams to ensure that each release meets the required functional and quality standards.

6. A Day in the Life:

As a core Software QA Engineer, your day will begin with the regional team’s morning stand-up to review development progress, testing priorities and outstanding defects. You will review requirements and acceptance criteria, prepare and execute test cases, validate APIs and database records, and test web or mobile functions across different scenarios. You will document defects clearly, work with developers to identify root causes, perform regression testing and confirm that completed fixes are ready for release.

7. Key Responsibilities:

• Review business requirements, functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria.

• Prepare test plans, test scenarios, test cases and test data for web, mobile and backend systems.

• Conduct functional, integration, regression, system, usability and user acceptance testing.

• Test REST APIs, database transactions and system integrations.

• Identify, document and track software defects with clear reproduction steps, screenshots, logs and supporting evidence.

• Work closely with developers, project managers and business users to investigate and resolve defects.

• Verify completed fixes and ensure that changes do not affect existing functions.

• Maintain test documentation, defect records, regression suites and release-quality reports.

• Support automated testing using appropriate tools and frameworks.

• Ensure that software releases meet agreed functional, security, performance and quality requirements.

8. Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering or a related field.

• Relevant experience in software quality assurance, software testing or application support.

• Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, the software development lifecycle and defect management.

• Experience testing web applications, mobile applications, REST APIs and database integrations.

• Hands-on experience with tools such as Postman, Swagger, Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium or similar testing tools.

• Familiarity with SQL and the ability to validate data directly from databases.

• Experience using defect and project-tracking tools such as Jira, YouTrack, Azure DevOps or similar platforms.

• Basic understanding of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS would be an advantage.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to detail.

• Ability to communicate defects clearly and work independently in a remote environment.

9. Remote Work Requirements:

• A dedicated, quiet workspace at home.

• A stable and reliable internet connection with a minimum speed of 10 Mbps.

• A backup power source, such as a UPS or power station, and a backup internet connection to ensure continuous availability during working hours.

• A reliable computer capable of supporting development and testing tools. Minimum specifications:

o Intel Core i5/i7, 11th Generation or later;

o AMD Ryzen 5/7, 5000 Series or later; or

o Apple Silicon M1, M2 or M3.

• Minimum 16 GB RAM and 256 GB NVMe SSD. HDD boot drives are not accepted.

• At least one high-resolution external monitor is highly recommended.

11. Benefits & Perks

a. Monthly WFH Allowance:

?2,000 monthly stipend to subsidize fibre internet and electricity costs.

b. Healthcare Security:

Comprehensive HMO coverage upon regularisation after six months.

c. Pathway to Singapore:

Outstanding candidates may have the opportunity to relocate to our Singapore headquarters after demonstrating consistent and validated good performance. Full visa sponsorship will be provided for approved relocations.

12. Our Hiring Process:

a. Initial HR Screening — 15 minutes

b. Brief QA Technical Assessment or Portfolio Review

c. Final Interview with the Singapore Tech Lead

d. Offer

title: Appointment Setter - Outbound B2B Calls (we give you the leads)
description:
We sell AI-integrated websites to small businesses in the US. B2B. Your job is to call

them and book a 15-minute appointment. That's it. You do not sell. You do not quote

prices. You book the meeting and move on.



WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT



You are not cold calling from a phone book. We hand you the leads, already researched,

each one with a specific reason to call. You get a browser dialer with live

transcription and an AI assistant that helps you mid-call if you want it. Your

follow-up texts are written for you off your own call recording.



WHAT YOU'D ACTUALLY DO
dials per day

- Ask for the owner or decision-maker by name

- Open with the specific reason you're calling, not a pitch

- Handle "I'm not interested" without arguing

- Book a 15-minute call with our closer, confirm the time out loud, send the invite

- Log what you learned so the closer knows what to open with



You will hear "no" a lot. The people who do well here are the ones who don't take it

personally and just dial the next one.



WHAT IT PAYS



- Base pay: $3/hour USD, part-time (about 20 hours per week) - roughly $260/month,

  paid every two weeks whether or not anything books

- On top of the base: $75 for every demo that is HELD (the prospect shows up and the

  call actually happens)

- $150 more when a demo you booked becomes a sale

- Paid every two weeks. Contractor.



So a normal month with 12 held demos and 3 of them closing is about $1,610 - the $260

base plus $1,350 on top. Twenty held with five closing is about $2,510.



No-shows do not pay. That is deliberate: it puts the incentive on booking people who

are actually going to be there, not on padding a calendar.



WHAT YOU NEED



- Clear, natural spoken English. A US business owner should never have to say "what?"

- A reliable computer, headset and internet

- You can work US Eastern morning hours. Owners answer early, so the first two hours

  of your day matter more than the rest.



Part time, about 20 hours per week, and your hours must overlap US Eastern morning.



What you'd be booking demos for: scsai.app/studio



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with this exact phrase: DIALS



Include:

1. A 60-second voice recording (or just an audio file) where you read this out loud

   as if you were on a real call:



   "Hi, is this Danny? Danny, I'm calling from SCS AI, quick one. I was looking at

   your business online - do you have a website for it right now?"



2. How many dials a day you've done before, and at what job

title: Senior Real Estate Operations VA & Trust Account Coordinator (Australia)
description:
We are Thy Property Agency, a rapidly scaling Australian real estate agency operating across multiple states. We are looking for a highly proactive, experienced Senior Real Estate Virtual Assistant from the Philippines to manage our backend systems, multi-state compliance, and automated B2B sales pipelines.



Employment Type (Trial to Permanent):

Please note: This position will begin as a project-based Gig/Contract role so we can assess your execution during the initial agency setup phase. Upon successful completion of the setup and demonstration of your capabilities, this will officially transition into a permanent Part-Time or Full-Time role.



Working Hours:

Must be available to work during standard Australian Western Standard Time (AWST) or Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST) business hours.



First Week Timeline & Expectations:

We operate at a fast pace and expect immediate impact. Your first week will be strictly time-boxed as follows:





Days 1–3 (Setup & SOPs): Work directly alongside Oxbridge Support to finalize all tech integrations (MantisProperty CRM, Google Workspace, Website) and fully document all standard operating procedures (SOPs) and workflows.





Days 4–5 (Lead Generation): Pivot immediately to active revenue generation. You will take over the existing backlog of leads, make outbound qualification calls, and initiate the sales pipeline.



Key Responsibilities:





CRM & Lead Management: Use MantisProperty as the central hub to syndicate listings to over 220 portals (
, Domain) and route all incoming leads. You must be able to claim a lead and execute a qualification phone call within 15 minutes.





Contracts & Trust Accounting: Draft and manage state-specific sales contracts using DocuSign, SecureExchange, or ListReady. Route deposits correctly based on whether the deal uses our independent Sales Trust or the Oxbridge Trust.





Sales & Cross-Selling: Confidently followscript frameworks to qualify buyers (investor vs. owner-occupier) and actively cross-sell our in-house finance and brokerage services.





B2B Workflows: Onboard new builders and developers, upload signed B2B agreements, log commission structures into the CRM, and generate commission invoices upon unconditional contracts.





Agent Onboarding: Assist in onboarding new Australian sales agents to our network by verifying multi-state licenses, CPD records, and provisioning system access.



Essential Skills & Qualifications:





Australian Real Estate Experience: Minimum 3+ years working directly with Australian real estate agencies. You must know Australian property terminology, compliance, and portal feeds.





System Proficiency: Advanced experience with Australian CRMs (MantisProperty highly preferred, but VaultRE, Rex, or similar is acceptable).





Trust & Contracts Knowledge: Proven understanding of Australian real estate trust accounting compliance and contract generation.





Communication: Exceptional spoken and written English. You will be calling Australian buyers and developers directly.





Infrastructure: Must have reliable, high-speed internet and a robust power backup system (UPS/Generator) to ensure zero downtime during Australian business hours.



How to Apply:

Please submit your resume along with a brief cover letter.





IMPORTANT: To prove you have read this description and possess the required knowledge, your cover letter MUST include the answer to the following question:





Briefly outline the standard compliance steps you would take when processing a buyer's deposit into an Australian trust account.

title: Product Researcher
description:
Type of Work: Project-Based / Part-Time

Initial Task: Find 5 products from 5 different suppliers

Pay: Negotiable



i. About the Project



I’m building a fashion store focused on premium-looking Y2K, whimsical vintage, fairy, coquette, and feminine dresses.







I am not looking for cheap, basic, generic, or mass-produced-looking dresses. The products must feel unique and visually strong enough to be sold as premium fashion.



ii. The Task



Find 5 potential supplier with one matching dress from each.



Each product MUST

* Be available as a single-unit order

* Have no minimum order quantity

* Allow retail ordering, dropshipping, or agent purchasing

* Closely match the requested Y2K and whimsical style

* Have clear product photos and sizing

* Be available for international shipping

* Come from a legitimate and verifiable supplier



iii. Information Required



For each supplier and product, provide:

* Supplier name

* Country

* Supplier website

* Business

* Supplier type

* Product name

* Product link

* Product price

* Shipping cost

* Delivery estimate

* Single-unit available?

* Dropshipping available?

* Private label available?

* Proof of supplier legitimacy

* Short notes (feel free to say your thoughts about it)



You can submit it through sharable Google Spreadsheet link or you can also message me here directly for lesser work. It is both acceptable. 



You may research through:



* Taobao

* Tmall

* 1688 through a purchasing agent

* Xiaohongshu / RedNote

* CJ Dropshipping

* HyperSKU

* SourcinBox

* EPROLO

* Independent fashion suppliers

* Verified private agents

* Fashion wholesale or retail websites



Do not submit five products from only one platform.



iv. Do Not Submit

* Products requiring an MOQ

* Counterfeit or branded replicas

* Basic bodycon dresses with no unique details

* Suppliers using stolen or inconsistent photos

* Stores with no verifiable contact information

* Products with unclear materials or sizing

* Suppliers with suspicious reviews

* Five sellers offering the exact same product

* Used or vintage resale listings



v. Quality Standard



Prioritize:

* Good fabric composition

* Lined or non-sheer construction

* Strong stitching and finishing

* Accurate size charts

* Unique silhouettes

* Premium product photography

* Consistent customer reviews

* Designs that are not widely available in common fast-fashion stores



vi. How to Apply



Start your application with WHIMSY.



Briefly describe your supplier and product-research experience, the platforms you use, and how you verify that a supplier is legitimate.(Short sentence will do)



This will begin as a small paid research project. A candidate who provides accurate, high-quality results may receive ongoing supplier and apparel product-research work and could be my right hand in the future. 



Kindly also include your salary rate /hr and preferred payment method.



Sounds like a lot of work? Don't sweat it. I am the nicest person you'll ever met— well, good luck to your research and don't forget to breathe!



Best, 

K

title: Content strategy / editing / social media
description:
About the role



I run a growing social media page focused on self-development, sport, mental health, and light investment content. I record raw video myself and need someone to own everything else: from idea to published post. I used to do everything myself, and I can't do all the business by myself so I need support. 



This is not a "just edit what I send you" role. I need someone who thinks like a content strategist first, editor second.



What you'll actually do



1. Content strategy & ideation



Research trending audio, formats, and hooks in the self-development / mindset / fitness / mental health niches

Propose weekly/monthly content ideas based on what's currently performing well (not just what's trendy in general — what fits this page's tone and audience)

Balance two goals: content built for reach (viral/discovery potential) vs. content built for retention (builds trust, brings people back, nurtures existing followers)

Suggest hooks, captions, and angles before I even record, so my raw footage is shot with a clear purpose



2. Editing (simple, fast-paced style)



Turn raw clips into finished Reels/TikToks/Shorts: cuts, captions, pacing, trending sounds, simple transitions

Nothing overly produced — clean, scroll-stopping, native-feeling short-form content

Consistent visual style/branding across posts



3. Posting & light community management



Schedule and publish across platforms (Instagram/TikTok, possibly YouTube Shorts)

Write captions and hashtags aligned with the strategy

Basic engagement: replying to comments/DMs in my voice (guidelines provided)



4. Performance tracking



Track what's working (views, saves, shares, follower growth) and adjust the content plan accordingly

Monthly summary: what worked, what didn't, what to try next

What I bring

Raw footage, filmed simply per your direction/hooks

Overall brand voice, values, and topics

Feedback loop — we'll review performance together regularly

What I'm looking for

Strong understanding of short-form trends (Reels/TikTok) — ideally with a portfolio in fitness, mindset, personal development, or similar niches

Comfortable with CapCut or similar fast-editing tools

Can think strategically, not just execute — I want opinions and pitches, not just a task-doer

Good written English for captions/community replies

Reliable, proactive communicator (Slack/Notion/Trello — happy to adapt to what you use)

Bonus: interest in personal development, sport, or investing yourself — it'll show in the content

Structure



Part-time to start, 5/10 videos edited & posted per week (negotiable)

Paid trial task before any long-term commitment: I'll send you 2–3 raw clips + you pitch a content plan for 1 week

Long-term potential for the right person as the page grows



To apply, please send:



2–3 examples of Reels/TikToks you've edited (ideally in a similar niche)

A quick note on what you think makes short-form content in the self-development/fitness space perform well right now

Your availability (hours/week, timezone overlap)



Of course we can brainstorm at the begining to define the strategy etc, you won't have to do everything yourself.

title: Construction Estimator
description:
ABOUT US



Backyard Estates is a turnkey design-build ADU (Accessory Dwelling Unit) company based in Upland, California, CSLB License #1076065. We design, permit, and build detached accessory dwelling units for homeowners across the Inland Empire and Los Angeles County.



A few numbers that describe how we operate:



- 8 week average build time from groundbreaking to final

- 20 consecutive projects in the City of Upland with zero plan check rejections

- Approximately 40 builds per year today, with a documented plan to reach 150 per year

- A licensed architect on staff who performs every site visit personally



We are a systems company that happens to build houses. Our process is documented, repeatable, and measured. We are hiring an estimator who will thrive inside that kind of environment.



This is not an administrative assistant position. This is a construction operations role.





THE ROLE IN ONE SENTENCE



You turn our field notes into a complete, accurate, client-ready proposal.





HOW THE WORK ACTUALLY FLOWS



This is the part most job posts leave out, so we will be specific.



1. The site visit happens. Adam (President) and Serge (our licensed architect) go to the property together. We photograph, measure, and document the site: setbacks, side yard clearances, utility runs, panel location, sewer tie-in, grade, access, and every condition that will drive cost.



2. The notes come to you. You receive the FPA (Formal Property Analysis) package: the architect's team notes, Adam's notes, site photos, video walkthroughs, siting and buildable area output, hazard zone findings, and Title 24 climate zone data.



3. You read everything and think. You identify scope items and cost drivers. You compare what you were given against what a complete estimate requires. Where something is missing, you flag it and ask. This is a core duty, not an afterthought. We would far rather answer your question than discover an assumption three weeks into construction.



4. You build the estimate. Using our standard inclusions, our cost catalog, and our established pricing, you produce a line item estimate in Buildertrend.



5. You build the proposal. You assemble the client-ready proposal in our format, to our standard, with clear scope language a homeowner can actually read and understand.



6. You close the loop. After the job is built, you compare estimated cost against actual cost, and you tell us where we were wrong and why. Over time this is the single most valuable thing you will do for us.





RESPONSIBILITIES



Estimating and Proposal Production

- Review FPA site packages and interpret field notes, photos, and video into a defined scope of work

- Produce detailed line item cost estimates using our established pricing standards

- Build and price allowances, upgrades, and optional scope

- Write clear, client-readable scope descriptions in English

- Assemble complete proposals in our format and to our quality standard

- Price change orders and scope adjustments on active projects

- Call California city building and planning departments, utility providers, suppliers, and subcontractors directly to resolve scope questions, confirm requirements, and clarify quoted pricing. This is a regular part of the work, not an occasional one

- Flag missing information and route questions to Adam or the architect before the estimate is finalized



Buildertrend Ownership

- Maintain and expand our cost catalog and cost codes

- Build and refine estimate templates for our standard ADU sizes and configurations

- Maintain proposal, purchase order, and change order templates

- Keep every job's records organized and current

- Improve workflows as we scale volume



Pricing Accuracy

- Maintain the labor and material pricing database

- Update supplier and subcontractor pricing on a set schedule

- Perform estimate versus actual reviews on completed jobs

- Report on where our estimates drift and recommend corrections



Process and Systems

- Document what you do so the next person can do it the same way

- Help build the SOPs that make estimating repeatable at 150 builds per year

- Use AI assisted tools where they improve speed and consistency without sacrificing accuracy





THE GROWTH PATH



We are being straight with you about this because we do not want to oversell it.



Our estimating function is small and we are building it now. Our intention is that the person in this seat grows into either Lead Estimator or Project Manager within 12 months, and we will look at people already on the team first when those roles open. That is our stated intention and our plan, not a guarantee. Whether it happens depends on your accuracy, your judgment, and your ownership of the work.



If you perform, the responsibility and the compensation grow with you.





REQUIRED



- Construction estimating experience, with real quantity takeoff work

- Ability to take off from photographs, video, and field notes, not only from finished drawings

- Buildertrend experience, or demonstrated ability to learn a construction platform quickly

- Residential construction knowledge, ideally single family, ADU, or new construction

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Excellent written English. You are writing documents a California homeowner will read and sign

- Comfort calling US city departments, suppliers, and subcontractors in English by phone to work through a requirement or challenge a quoted price. You will do this often

- Comfort on live video calls in English with our US team

- The judgment to flag a gap instead of quietly filling it with an assumption

- Documented experience working a full overnight schedule. After estimating skill, this is the single most important requirement

- A track record of working inside someone else's format and process

- Your own computer and a reliable primary and backup internet connection





PREFERRED



- California residential construction exposure, especially ADU work

- Familiarity with Title 24, CalGreen, or California plan check processes

- Experience with any of: Buildxact, JobTread, Bluebeam, PlanSwift, Procore, STACK

- Civil engineering or architecture background

- CRM experience, Pipedrive preferred

- CSI division format familiarity





THE SCHEDULE. PLEASE READ THIS TWICE.



This is a night shift. We are not going to describe it as anything else.



You must be available and working 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Pacific time, Monday through Friday. In Manila that is:



- Roughly 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM, from March to November

- Roughly 11:00 PM to 9:00 AM, from November to March



This is a full overnight schedule and it is a condition of the engagement, not a preference.



Here is why we are firm on it. This role calls California city building departments, planning counters, utility providers, and subcontractors to resolve real questions on live estimates. Those offices are open during our business hours and no other time. An estimator who cannot make those calls is an estimator who guesses, and we do not build from guesses. Estimates also stall when a question to Adam or the architect sits unanswered for 12 hours.



We will ask which overnight schedules you have actually worked, for which company, for how long, and what routine made it sustainable. We are asking for history, not willingness. If you have not worked overnights before, this is not the right role for you, and we would rather say so now than three months from now.



After 12 months this schedule may become more flexible as the team grows. We are telling you that it is possible, not promising it, and you should accept this role only if the schedule above works for you indefinitely.





WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



First 30 days

- You understand our standard inclusions, our build process, and our proposal format

- You have rebuilt 3 past estimates and matched the original within an agreed tolerance

- You know which questions to ask and who to ask



First 90 days

- You are producing complete estimates and proposals from FPA packages independently

- Our Buildertrend cost catalog and cost codes are clean and current

- Estimate templates exist for each of our standard ADU sizes

- Proposal, purchase order, and change order templates are standardized

- Your turnaround from FPA package to finished proposal is consistent and predictable



First 12 months

- Estimate versus actual variance is tracked on every completed job and trending down

- Our estimating process is documented well enough to train the next person

- You are ready for Lead Estimator or Project Manager consideration





BEFORE YOU APPLY, PLEASE VERIFY US



Job scams are common and careful candidates are usually the best candidates, so please verify us before you apply. All of this is public and free to check.



- California Contractors State License Board, License #1076065, issued to Backyard Estates

- Our office is 2335 W Foothill Blvd, Suite 18, Upland, CA 91786



We will never ask you to pay for anything. We will never ask you to use your personal bank account or GCash for company money. We will never ask for your bank details before a signed agreement. We will never ask you to perform unpaid work as part of hiring. Our application asks about work you have already done.





OUR HIRING PROCESS



1. You submit your application with the answers below. About 15 minutes.

2. We acknowledge every application and tell you when you will hear from us.

3. A 45 minute live video conversation.

4. A short paid estimating exercise using a real, anonymized FPA package, so you can see the work and we can see your thinking. Paid, because your time has value.

5. Offer and onboarding.



Start to finish, roughly two to three weeks. You will hear from us at every stage, including if the answer is no.





HOW TO APPLY



Please include this exact subject line: Structure Creates Success



Applications that do not include the subject line will not be reviewed.



In your application, answer each of the following:



1. Years of construction estimating experience

2. Years of Buildertrend experience, and the specific features you have used

3. What construction sectors you have estimated for (residential, ADU, remodeling, commercial, etc.)

4. Have you prepared complete estimates from photos, video, or field notes rather than finished plans? Briefly explain how

5. What estimating and project management software you have used

6. Describe your largest project by value and your specific role in it

7. Tell us about a time you found missing information mid-estimate. What did you do?

8. Every overnight schedule you have actually worked: the hours, the company, how long you held it, and what routine made it sustainable

9. Confirm you can work 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Pacific, Monday through Friday, on an ongoing basis

10. Describe a call you have made to a US vendor, agency, or subcontractor to resolve a pricing or scope question

11. Your expected monthly rate in USD

12. Examples of estimate templates, cost catalogs, or proposals you have built. Attach samples if you can



Please attach your resume named: Lastname_ADU_Estimator.pdf



Please also record a 2 minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you are a strong fit for this role.



We are building the operational foundation of a company that intends to become the premier ADU builder in Southern California. If you take pride in building the system that lets an entire company grow, we would like to meet you.

title: Account Manager Assistant for Marketing Agency
description:
Thanks for your interest in the Account Manager Assistant for Marketing Agency role.



This is a remote operations role supporting a US-based digital marketing agency’s client account management team. We need someone who has previously worked inside a marketing agency or directly supported multiple clients. Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks before, during, or after client meetings. AI use is encuraged to be used but you need to be the human in the loop. ai is constantly making mistakes and I need you to catch them not just blindly following what it says



You will process call notes and transcripts, create and maintain tasks, draft client recap and response
s, monitor overdue or unassigned work, and step in to help move work forward when and where you can. I often still jump in to get things across the finishline and expect that you will do the samw once you get your feet under you. You will also prepare meeting briefs, reports, and keep CRM records, client files, and communication logs organized and current.



We have frequent internal meetings, so you must be comfortable joining video calls, communicating clearly, and following through afterward.



this is not a generic virtual assistant role. You must have real experience in a marketing agency or similar using a project-management tool and a CRM, deadlines, follow-up, and communication. ClickUp, Google Workspace, and GoHighLevel experience are strong advantages.



We use Hubstaff for clocking in and out, it does take activity screenshots. You must be comfortable working transparently within that system. No one likes, I dont like this, but ive caught too many with 2 jobs not getting work done. 



We need consistent overlap with US Eastern or Mountain Time business hours.



To be direct, please do not waste your time or mine by applying if you do not have relevant marketing-agency experience, project-management-tool experience, CRM experience, comfort joining video meetings, and reliable availability during US business hours.



If you meet those requirements, please send a 3 to 5 minute video through Upwork answering these questions: I know big ask for first round.



1. What marketing agency experience do you have? What services, clients, or account-management work did you support?

2. What tools have use used and how have the affected the outcomes for the clients.

3. How comfortable are you joining video meetings, taking notes, and managing the follow-up work afterward?

4. Tell me about a time you caught a missed detail, overdue task, or client risk before it became a larger problem.

5. What hours can you consistently work in US Eastern or Mountain Time, and how many hours per week are you available?



Please keep your video direct and specific. We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented operator who can protect the client experience and keep work moving without constant reminders.

title: Creative Strategist (E-commerce)
description:
Maison Cosmetics is a fast-growing DTC skincare brand focused on premium, ingredient-led products for women 40+. We launched in the DACH market in January and have already converted more than 100,000 customers. We recently opened the US and our next phase is to keep growing steadily in DACH while cracking and scaling the US.



Creative is the engine behind our growth. Paid social is our main acquisition channel and we are scaling across Meta, TikTok, Google and other channels. We produce a high volume of creative every week, supported by an AI-driven production team.



The role



We are looking for a Senior Creative Strategist who owns the creative pipeline end to end: from research and angle development, to scripts and briefs, to clear visual direction for our production team, to reading performance data and d
 what gets iterated next.



This is not a copywriting role and not a designer role. You are the person who d
 what we say, to whom, and why it will convert.



What you will do



Develop new direct response angles based on customer research, survey data, reviews and competitor intelligence

Write high-converting scripts.



Brief and give clear visual direction to our AI-driven production team

Build and maintain a testing roadmap: hooks, angles, formats, hierarchy of what to test next

Analyze creative performance and turn learnings into the next round of concepts

Localize and adapt winning concepts across DACH and US markets



Who we are looking for



3+ years of hands-on creative strategy for DTC brands with meaningful paid social spend

Proven track record of concepts that scaled, ideally in beauty, skincare, supplements or health

You think in angles and mechanisms, not in taglines

Strong writing in English, native-level tone for the US market

Comfortable working from data: post-purchase surveys, reviews, ad account performance

Fast, high volume, iterative. You would rather ship ten concepts and learn than polish one for a week

Self-directed. You bring the roadmap, we do not hand you a task list



What we offer



Full ownership of creative strategy for a brand that is already scaling, not a startup looking for product market fit

Long-term, full-time contract with room to grow into creative leadership as we expand internationally

Performance-based bonus on top of your base rate

Direct line to the founders, no layers, decisions made same day

Real budget behind your ideas, so your work gets tested at scale within days



Details



Type: long-term contract, full-time (40 hours per week)

Location: fully remote



How to apply



Please do not send a generic cover letter. Instead, include the following:



Two or three ads you personally conceptualized that scaled. Tell us the angle behind each one and why you believe it worked.

One angle you would test for us in week one, in three sentences. Look at our brand first: 

Your availability and your rate.



Applications without a specific angle in point 2 will not be reviewed.

title: Senior WordPress Developer
description:
We’re a UK-based digital agency looking for an experienced Senior WordPress Developer to join our team full-time.



We’re looking for someone who is comfortable handling WordPress projects from development to launch, not just someone who knows how to use a page builder.



You’ll be working on websites for clients across different industries, including new builds, existing website improvements, landing pages, maintenance, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.



What You’ll Be Doing

Building WordPress websites from Figma designs

Developing responsive pages for desktop, tablet, and mobile

Working with Elementor and other WordPress tools when needed

Customizing themes, templates, and existing WordPress websites

Writing custom HTML, CSS, and JavaScript when a page builder isn’t enough

Troubleshooting WordPress, plugin, theme, and layout issues

Improving website speed, performance, and Core Web Vitals

Handling website migrations, staging sites, backups, and deployments

Implementing basic technical and on-page SEO requirements

Testing websites across different devices and browsers before launch

Working closely with designers to make sure the final website matches the approved design

Maintaining and improving existing client websites

Using AI tools to help with development, debugging, research, documentation, and day-to-day productivity

What We’re Looking For

Strong professional experience with WordPress development

Strong experience with Elementor

Good knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

Comfortable working with custom WordPress code when necessary

Experience working with themes, child themes, plugins, hooks, and WordPress templates

Understanding of PHP and the WordPress ecosystem

Experience with responsive development and cross-browser testing

Good understanding of website performance, caching, image optimization, and Core Web Vitals

Familiar with website migrations, hosting, DNS, SSL, staging, and general WordPress troubleshooting

Basic understanding of technical and on-page SEO

Comfortable using Git or another version control workflow

Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or similar tools to improve development productivity

Able to troubleshoot problems independently instead of relying entirely on plugins or page builders

Good English communication skills

Reliable internet connection and a proper work-from-home setup



Experience with WooCommerce, ACF, Gutenberg, custom post types, REST APIs, Webflow, hosting/server management, or third-party integrations is a plus.



We don’t expect you to know everything, but you should be comfortable researching and figuring things out when you encounter something new.



Salary & Schedule



The salary for this position is $1,600–$2,300 USD per month, depending on your experience, technical skills, and quality of work.



This is a full-time, long-term remote position.



Our agency is based in the UK, so you must be willing to work UK hours/timezone. Please make sure you're comfortable with this schedule before applying.



How to Apply



Please include the following:



Portfolio / Sample Work – Send links to WordPress websites you’ve personally worked on. Please briefly mention what you were responsible for on each project.

Resume/CV Link – Provide a shareable link to your updated resume.

Video Introduction – Send a video introduction that is at least 1 minute long. Tell us about yourself, your WordPress experience, the tools you normally use, and the types of projects you’ve worked on.

AI Experience – Briefly tell us how you currently use AI tools in your development workflow.



Please double-check that all links are accessible before submitting your application.



Applications without sample work, a resume link, and a video introduction will not be considered.



We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of their work, solve problems without needing constant supervision, and become a reliable long-term member of our team.
