title: Move Coordinator
description:
We are looking for an organized, customer-focused Move Coordinator to manage international household goods relocations from origin to destination. In this role, you will guide customers through every stage of the moving process, ensuring a seamless experience while coordinating with internal teams, vendors, shipping partners, and customs authorities.



As the primary point of contact for our clients, you will play a key role in delivering outstanding service, proactive communication, and efficient move management. This position is ideal for someone with experience in relocation services, logistics, freight forwarding, or courier operations who enjoys solving problems and helping customers navigate complex moves.



Key Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the relocation process.

Provide timely, professional communication and respond to all inquiries within 24 hours.

Build trust and confidence by setting clear expectations and providing regular updates.

Move Coordination

Plan, coordinate, and oversee all aspects of household goods moves, including:

Packing

Transportation

Storage

Customs clearance

Final delivery

Ensure moves are completed on time and in accordance with service commitments.

Documentation & Compliance

Prepare and review shipping instructions, customs documents, invoices, and operational paperwork.

Ensure compliance with company procedures and international relocation standards.

Shipment Tracking & Reporting

Maintain accurate shipment status updates in company systems.

Monitor progress proactively and communicate any delays, changes, or issues to clients.

Problem Resolution

Manage service disruptions, exceptions, customer concerns, and claims professionally and efficiently.

Identify solutions that minimize delays and maintain customer satisfaction.

Financial Administration

Coordinate with Sales, Finance, Billing teams, and vendors to ensure accurate invoicing.

Collect required prepayments from customers before service delivery when applicable.

Qualifications & Experience



Required

Minimum 1 year of experience in logistics coordination, moving services, freight forwarding, or a related field.

Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving abilities.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.



Preferred

Experience coordinating household goods (HHG) relocations.

Experience in courier, parcel delivery, or international shipping operations.

French language skills are an advantage.



What Success Looks Like



Our customers trust us with an important and personal transition in their lives. The ideal Move Coordinator will:



Communicate clearly and confidently with customers.

Explain services and processes in simple, easy-to-understand language.

Set realistic timelines and manage expectations effectively.

Provide reassurance and support throughout the move.

Collaborate seamlessly with customers, vendors, shipping lines, customs authorities, and internal teams.

Work Requirements

Available to work 2:00 PM - 11:00 PM Philippine Time (PHT) to support European business hours.

Willing to provide after-hours support during active moves when required.

Comfortable working as part of a centralized, cross-trained coordination team handling files across multiple countries.

Must have:

Reliable personal laptop suitable for business use.

Dedicated and quiet home office workspace.

Stable, high-speed internet connection.

Seasonal Requirements



Our busiest period is during the summer relocation season. Tea
mbers are expected to be available during this period, with vacation generally limited to one week and subject to team coordination.



To support work-life balance, extended leave opportunities are encouraged during the quieter winter season.



Why Join Us?

Work remotely from anywhere in the Philippines.

Be part of a dynamic international relocation team.

Gain exposure to global logistics and mobility operations.

Play a meaningful role in helping individuals and families relocate successfully across borders.



Interested? We'd love to hear from you. Apply today and help deliver exceptional relocation experiences across Europe and the Balkans.

title: AI-Powered Graphic & Video Designer
description:
AI-Powered Graphic & Video Designer



About i-screen

i-screen is Australia’s largest consumer health-screening company, offering DNA, blood, gut health and metabolic testing across Australia, New Zealand, Singapore and the UK. We’re a fast-moving health-tech brand investing heavily in AI, and we need a designer who can help our visual brand keep pace with that ambition.



The role

We’re looking for a creative designer to produce imagery for our website and images and video for our marketing collateral and newsletters. This is a contract role, roughly 3 days per week, working remotely from the Philippines and aligned where possible to Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT). You’ll work directly with our Marketing and AI teams.



What you’ll do

• Create professional, on-brand images for the i-screen website and landing pages

• Produce images and short-form video for marketing campaigns, social channels and
 newsletters

• Use AI ad-creation platforms as your primary delivery engine to produce high-quality, testable output fast

• Reach for generative AI engines when we need bespoke, truly on-brand assets that off-the-shelf tools can’t deliver

• Adapt and refine assets to suit a premium, credible health and science brand

• Turn briefs around quickly and iterate based on feedback



How we think about AI tools

We’re deliberately moving away from purely manual, traditional design workflows. We think about AI creative tooling in two layers, and we want someone fluent in both:

• Ad-creation platforms (our main workflow): purpose-built tools that turn a brief, brand kit or product URL into finished, testable image and video ads fast, for example Creatify, Arcads, AdCreative.ai, HeyGen or Captions.

• Generative engines (for bespoke work): the underlying tools used to craft custom imagery and video from scratch, for example Midjourney, Runway, Google Veo, Kling, Adobe Firefly, Flux or Ideogram.

The ideal person uses the platform layer to move quickly and the engine layer when the brand needs something custom, rather than relying on any single tool.



Essential

• Proven graphic design experience with a strong portfolio we can review

• Demonstrated, hands-on experience with AI ad-creation platforms (e.g. Creatify, Arcads, AdCreative.ai) and generative AI engines (e.g. Midjourney, Runway, Veo). You must be able to show examples of AI-assisted work you’ve produced

• A genuinely good eye for what looks professional, clean and premium, and the judgement to know what suits a premium health brand, including what is appropriate and credible rather than just what converts

• Video creation and editing capability for short-form marketing and social content

• Excellent written English and reliable communication

• Self-motivated, able to work independently and show value quickly with minimal supervision

• A stable internet connection and your own equipment



Nice to have

• Experience in health, wellness, science or premium consumer brands

• Motion graphics / basic animation

• Experience designing for
 newsletters and social platforms (Instagram, TikTok,
, LinkedIn)

• Prior digital marketing experience, with exposure to tools like Google Ads, Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager and similar platforms

• Working knowledge of traditional design tools (Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, Figma) as a complement to AI workflows



Engagement details

• Contract, approximately 3 days per week

• Fully remote from the Philippines

• Monthly rate (competitive, discussed at interview)



How to apply

Send your CV and portfolio with clear examples of AI-assisted design and video work, a short note on which AI tools you use and how (both ad-creation platforms and generative engines), and your monthly rate for a 3-day-per-week contract to

title: Online English/World History Teachers (Near-Native Accent)
description:

title: Instagram Outreach & Lead Research VA — Music Marketing Agency (Long-Term)
description:
Maxx Volume is a U.S.-based music marketing company. We help independent artists grow real fanbases through advertising and strategy — no bots, no playlist farms, no fake streams.



We are hiring one Virtual Assistant to find qualified independent artists on Instagram and run first-touch outreach from our account. This is a long-term role with room to grow into a paid appointment-setting position with bonuses.



You do NOT need to know the music industry. You DO need to be sharp, observant, and able to tell the difference between an artist who is serious about their career and one who is just posting for fun. We will train you on the rest.



------------------------------

WHAT YOU'LL DO EACH DAY

---------------------
. Research and add 15-25 NEW qualified artist leads to our Google Sheet.

2. Send personalized first-touch DMs from our Instagram account (script provided — you personalize each one).

3. Reply to and organize incoming DMs, tag warm conversations, and flag anyone ready for a call.

4. Send a short end-of-day summary: leads added, DMs sent, replies received, anyone hot.



------------------------------

WHAT A QUALIFIED LEAD LOOKS LIKE

------------------------------

We sell a premium 90-day program, so we only want artists who could realistically afford it and are already investing in themselves.



GREEN LIGHTS:

- Released music recently or clearly preparing a release

- Already spending money on their career: music videos, professional cover art, studio sessions, real photography, PR, playlist promotion, ads, or a manager/team

- Posts consistently on Instagram or TikTok

- Music and visuals are already at a decent level (marketing can actually help them)

- Some traction: roughly 1,000 to 100,000 Spotify monthly listeners, songs with 10K+ streams, solid video views, real engagement, shows, features, or press

- Talks about their music like a business and a career



RED FLAGS — DO NOT ADD THESE:

- No music released, or nothing released in a year or more

- Poor quality music or amateur visuals

- No sign they've spent a dollar on their career

- A few random posts, clearly a hobby

- Constantly asking people for free promo

- Bio says "DM for collabs" but nothing professional is happening

- Fake followers or obviously fake engagement (huge follower count, dead comments)



We would rather have 25 artists who could actually buy than 500 random artists.

QUALITY OVER QUANTITY. Every single time.



------------------------------

WHERE TO FIND THEM

------------------------------

- Instagram: artist pages, producer pages, recording studios, music photographers and videographers, music video directors, music marketing pages, and the artists those accounts tag

- Comment sections under music industry pages

- TikTok: indie artists promoting songs, artists with strong video views but weak streaming numbers, artists asking about Spotify growth or promotion

- Spotify: artists on independent playlists in our genres

- YouTube: professional-looking music videos with low view counts

- Music blogs, show flyers, and local event lineups



Studios, producers, engineers, and photographers are our best hunting grounds. If an artist is tagged at a studio or working with a paid photographer, they are already spending money — that's a strong buying signal.



------------------------------

WHAT GOES IN THE SHEET FOR EVERY LEAD

------------------------------

- 
 Spotify link

- Spotify monthly listeners

- Instagram follower count

- Best performing song

- Last release date

- Why they look qualified (1-2 sentences)

- The obvious problem we could solve for them (1 sentence)



If you can't fill in the last two lines with something real, it is not a lead.



------------------------------

WHAT WE ARE NOT

------------------------------

This is not spam. We do not copy-paste the same message 200 times a day. Every DM references something specific about that artist — their new single, their video, their numbers. Volume matters less to us than the quality of the conversation. If you send lazy, generic messages, this role is not for you.



------------------------------

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

------------------------------

- Excellent written English — your DMs must sound natural and human, not translated or robotic

- Comfortable on Instagram, TikTok, Spotify, and YouTube

- Strong research instincts — you enjoy digging and connecting dots

- Organized with Google Sheets

- Reliable daily communication, no ghosting

- Stable internet and a computer (this is not phone-only work)

- Bonus: you like music, follow artists, or have run social accounts before



------------------------------

HOURS, PAY, AND GROWTH

---------------------
hours per week to start, Monday to Friday

- Some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time required

- Paid weekly or twice monthly, your preference

- 1-week paid trial to start (paid regardless of outcome)

- After the trial: raises based on lead quality, plus bonuses for every lead that books a call and closes



------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

------------------------------

Applications that skip these steps get deleted. This is the filter.



1. Start your message with the word "VOLUME" so I know you read the whole post.



2. Answer these three questions:

   a) What is one specific thing you would look at on an artist's Instagram to tell whether they are spending real money on their career?

   b) Have you done outreach, lead research, or social media work before? Tell me what and for who.

   c) How many hours per week can you commit, and what are your working hours in EST?



3. Do this short sample task — this is what actually gets you hired:

   Go find ONE real independent artist on Instagram who you think fits the criteria above. Send me:

   - Their 
 Their Spotify monthly listeners

   - Their last release date

   - Two sentences on why you think they're qualified

   - One sentence on the problem we could solve for them

   - A 3-4 sentence DM you would send them (in your own words)



I read every application that follows the instructions. Looking to hire this week and keep this person long-term.

title: Virtual Tax Preparer
description:
Tax Agent — Wilkins & Associates



South Carolina | Remote | 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM EST Required | Seasonal with Year-Round Growth Potential



Wilkins & Associates is a growing tax, accounting, and advisory firm serving individuals and small businesses across South Carolina and beyond. Our services include tax preparation, bookkeeping, payroll, IRS resolution, and CFO advisory. We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Tax Agent who is experienced in both individual and business tax returns to join our team for the current and upcoming tax seasons.



Compensation & Schedule

Competitive per-return or hourly pay (based on experience and production)

Bonus opportunities and long-term advancement

Required availability: 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Standard Time, Monday through Friday. This is a set schedule, not flexible hours. Applicants outside the Eastern time zone must be able to work these hours consistently.

Position Overview



The Tax Agent prepares and files accurate individual and business returns, researches tax positions before taking them, works directly with clients, and ensures full compliance with IRS regulations and firm standards. A significant portion of our client base consists of small business owners, so the ability to prepare business entity returns independently is required, not optional. Because this role involves direct verbal communication with clients, the ability to speak clear, professional English is also required. The role demands professionalism, sound judgment, and an unwavering commitment to accuracy and confidentiality.



Key Responsibilities



Business Return Preparation



Prepare and file S-corporation (1120-S), partnership (1065), and corporate (1120) returns as assigned

Prepare Schedule C, Schedule E, and Schedule F returns for sole proprietors, rental owners, and farm clients

Produce and reconcile Schedules K-1 and confirm they tie to the entity return

Track shareholder and partner basis, distributions, and capital accounts

Review reasonable compensation for S-corporation owners and flag concerns to the reviewer

Reconcile client books to the tax return and identify entries that require adjustment before filing

Handle depreciation schedules, fixed asset additions and disposals, Section 179, and bonus depreciation

Coordinate the flow between the business return and the owner's personal 1040



Individual Return Preparation & Filing



Prepare and file federal, state, and local individual returns, including multi-state filings

Build supporting schedules and workpapers (vehicle, home office, cost of goods sold, owner compensation)

Prepare extensions, estimated tax payments, and amended returns as needed

Monitor e-file acknowledgments, correct rejections, and confirm every return is accepted — not just transmitted



Tax Research (Required)



Conduct independent tax research on unclear, complex, or unusual client positions before a return is filed

Use IRS publications, the Internal Revenue Code, regulations, rulings, and professional research tools to reach a supportable conclusion

Document research findings in writing with the authority cited, and attach it to the client file

Research state and local filing requirements for entities operating in multiple jurisdictions

Stay current on tax law changes and bring anything that affects our client base to the review team



Client Work



Collect intake documents, review for completeness, and follow up on missing items

Review completed returns with clients by phone or video and explain results clearly in plain language

Identify tax exposure, risk, and savings opportunities and propose compliant solutions

Support tax planning and advisory conversations under the direction of senior staff

Assist with IRS and state notices, including transcript review and drafting responses on resolution cases



Compliance & Firm Standards



Confirm a signed engagement letter is in place for the specific service before any work begins; new or additional services require a new engagement letter

Obtain required client authorizations (including Forms 8821 and 7216 where applicable) before contacting taxing authorities or releasing information

Maintain strict compliance with IRS Circular 230, firm policy, and ethical standards

Safeguard all client data at the highest level of confidentiality

Apply for and maintain an active PTIN

Keep client records, notes, and status updates current in firm systems and CRM

Conduct client communication through the firm's client portal, not personal

Attend all required training and compliance sessions

Flag anything unclear to the reviewer before submission, not after

Required Qualifications

Demonstrated experience preparing business tax returns. Applicants must be able to independently prepare Form 1120-S and Form 1065, including K-1s, basis tracking, and depreciation schedules.

Proficiency with individual returns, including Form 1040 and Schedule C

Must be able to speak clear, professional English. This position requires live phone and video conversations with clients.

Availability to work 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM EST, Monday through Friday

Demonstrated ability to research a tax question and support the answer with authority

Strong working knowledge of current tax law and IRS regulations

Comfort reading and interpreting a client's financial statements to prepare an entity return

Strong written English for client
s, notes, and research memos

Excellent attention to detail and accuracy

Professional demeanor and strong client communication skills

Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Reliable internet connection and a secure personal computer

Ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced tax environment

Preferred (Not Required)

Enrolled Agent, CPA, CTEC, or active tax credential

Experience with Form 1120 (C-corporation) and Form 1041 (trusts and estates)

Experience with professional tax software and research platforms

Experience in a virtual or fully remote tax firm

Exposure to IRS resolution, notices, or transcript analysis

Working knowledge of QuickBooks or comparable bookkeeping software

Training & Support

Full onboarding and compliance training

Ongoing education, mentorship, and research support

Review and guidance from experienced senior tax staff

Growth Opportunity



High-performing Tax Agents may qualify for:



Year-round employment

Advisory and review roles

Leadership and management opportunities

Long-term career growth within Wilkins & Associates



To apply: submit your resume, credential information, and a summary of your business return experience — entity types, approximate volume per season, and the software you've used — to
.

. Cut and deliver 3-5 finished short-form clips per day from footage we send you (music videos, studio sessions, performances, screen recordings, talking-head footage).

2. Match a reference. We will send you example posts and say "make it like this." You need to be able to study a clip and replicate its pacing, captions, transitions, text style, and feel — accurately, without being walked through it.

3. Write clean captions and on-screen text. Correct spelling and grammar every single time. One typo goes out to thousands of people and makes our brand look amateur.

4. Post and schedule the finished clips to Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts on the schedule we set.

5. Keep the content folder organized — raw footage in, finished clips out, clear file naming, nothing lost.



------------------------------

THE STANDARD

---------------------
clips delivered daily, on time, no excuses and no chasing

- Turnaround is fast. Some days we will send footage and need clips back the same day.

- Deadlines here are firm. If you need three days to cut one Reel, this role will make you miserable.

- Quality does not drop because the deadline is tight. We would rather hear "I can do 3 great ones today" than receive 5 sloppy ones.



------------------------------

WHAT YOU NEED

------------------------------

- Strong short-form editing skills — hooks in the first second, tight pacing, clean cuts on beat, captions that are readable on a phone

- Proficiency in at least one professional editor: Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or CapCut Pro. Multiple is a big plus.

- Real experience editing music content — music videos, music clips, artist promo, or social clips for musicians. Tell us what you've worked on.

- Excellent written English. No spelling errors. No awkward phrasing. Your captions go out under our brand name.

- Good ear for music and rhythm — you can cut to a beat without being told where the beat is

- Reliable high-speed internet and a computer that can handle 4K footage without crashing

- Daily communication. Reachable during agreed hours. No ghosting.



NICE TO HAVE:

- Motion graphics / After Effects animation

- Thumbnail and cover art design (Photoshop, Canva, Figma)

- Color grading

- You actually listen to and care about music, and you know what performs on TikTok and Reels right now



------------------------------

HOURS, PAY, AND GROWTH

------------------------------

- Full time, Monday to Friday

- Some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time required

- Paid weekly or twice monthly, your preference

- 1-week paid trial to start (paid regardless of outcome)

- After the trial: raises tied to output and quality. As we grow, this role grows into Content Lead — building the schedule, directing style, and eventually managing other editors.



------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

------------------------------

Applications that skip these steps get deleted. This is the filter.



1. Start your message with the word "CUT" so I know you read the whole post.



2. Send your portfolio. Direct links only — Google Drive, Vimeo, YouTube, Behance, TikTok, or Instagram. If you have edited music content specifically, put those first and tell me which parts you personally cut.



3. Answer these:

   a) Which editing software do you use most, and how many years?

   b) Realistically, how many finished short-form clips can you deliver in one day at a high standard?

   c) What are your working hours in EST, and how fast do you typically reply to messages?

   d) Have you edited for musicians or artists before? Who, and what kind of content?



4. Do this test — this is what actually gets you hired:

   Find any independent artist's music video on YouTube. Cut a 20-30 second vertical clip from it for Instagram Reels — with a hook, captions, and text overlay, the way you would post it for a real client. Send me the link.

   I am judging: hook, pacing, caption quality, spelling, and whether it makes me want to keep watching.



I read every application that follows the instructions. Hiring this week and keeping this person long-term.

title: Credit Dispute Specialist (4+ Years, U.S. Companies) — Part-Time, Remote
description:
We are a licensed, bonded credit education and consulting company based in Miami, Florida. We serve mostly Spanish-speaking clients and operate strictly under U.S. federal law (CROA and FCRA) and Florida's Credit Service Organization statute. We do the work the right way — item-specific, evidence-based disputes. No shortcuts, no false promises.

We are a small team and we treat each other like one. You will work directly with the owner and our disputes supervisor. This is a long-term seat, not a task queue.

THIS ROLE IS FOR AN EXPERIENCED DISPUTER

We are not hiring someone to learn credit repair here. We need someone who has already run files end to end, read hundreds of bureau responses, and knows what to do when an item comes back "verified" for the third time. If that's you, keep reading.

SCHEDULE

9:00 PM to 1:00 AM Philippine Time, Monday to Friday

(9:00 AM to 1:00 PM Eastern Time, Miami)

Daylight saving adjustment is confirmed with you in writing.

PAY

$5.00 per hour to start

$5.50 per hour after 90 days

Reviewed again at six months and with each growth stage you reach

Merit increases available at any point

Paid twice a month — the 15th and the last day of the month — via Wise. We cover the transfer fees.

WHAT WE PROVIDE

Company VPN, DisputeFox access, and all systems needed for the work.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Pull and analyze tri-bureau credit reports (Equifax, Experian, TransUnion)

Identify inaccurate, incomplete, or unverifiable items: collections, charge-offs, late payments, duplicate accounts, incorrect personal information, unauthorized inquiries

Draft item-specific dispute letters under FCRA Section 1681i and Section 1681e(b)

Manage all client files, rounds, and progress inside DisputeFox

Track the 30-day bureau response window and log every result per file

Process bureau responses and run method-of-verification follow-ups on items returned "verified"

Send 623 direct disputes to furnishers and FDCPA validation requests to collectors when applicable

Call furnishers and collection agencies directly on 623 disputes and validation follow-ups

Call the credit bureaus' business lines about process questions, submission status, or documentation requirements

Prepare CFPB and FTC complaints when bureaus or furnishers fail to comply

Keep clean, audit-ready documentation on every file, including a log of every call: date, party, representative name, and outcome

REQUIREMENTS

Minimum 4 years of hands-on credit repair dispute experience with U.S.-based credit repair companies. We will verify this — expect to name the companies you worked for and provide at least one reference.

Experience in a credit repair platform. DisputeFox strongly preferred. If you have not used it, tell us which platform you know best and how quickly you have picked up new systems.

Hands-on experience with Metro 2 reporting. You should be able to read a tradeline's data fields and identify where the furnisher's reporting is inconsistent or non-compliant.

Excellent written English. Your letters go to federal agencies and credit bureaus.

Clear spoken English. This role includes phone contact with furnishers, collection agencies, and credit bureau business lines.

Working knowledge of the FCRA, FDCPA, and CROA, including what you are not allowed to do

Proven experience escalating past "verified" results: MOV requests, furnisher-direct disputes, regulatory complaints

Very high attention to detail. One wrong account number or date can cost a client a full round.

Reliable computer, headset, backup power and internet plan, and a quiet place to work

Willingness to work through our company VPN and handle all client data through company-provided systems only

Available for the full schedule window listed above

Strong communicator who raises questions instead of guessing

NICE TO HAVE

Spanish reading ability (bonus only, not required)

PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF

Your credit repair experience is outside the U.S. market

Your experience is sending blanket "not my account" or "permissible purpose" template disputes

You are looking for something short-term between other jobs

You cannot verify your years of experience

GROWTH

Your pay increases on a written schedule starting at 90 days, and is reviewed again at six months and with each growth stage you reach. Your hours grow with our active file volume — up to full-time, and eventually lead specialist running your own team. Every hire receives a written compensation and growth plan on day one, so you know exactly what the path looks like before you start.

HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word FCRA so we know you read the full post. Question 3 is the one that matters most — applicants who complete all six items will be scheduled for a short video interview.

Which U.S. credit repair companies you worked for, how long at each, and a contact who can confirm it

Which platforms you have worked in, and how many active files you carried at once

Walk us through one item you got removed AFTER the bureau came back "verified." What did you send next, and why?

A 60-second voice or video introduction covering your credit repair background

Your internet speed test result (screenshot or link)

Confirmation that you can work 9:00 PM to 1:00 AM Philippine Time

WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO

Senior lead developers, advanced engineers, and executive track technology leaders may qualify for compensation up to $3,000/month or more depending on the role, skill level, and performance.



In Philippine pesos, this may range roughly from around ?20,000/month for lower level roles to ?170,000+ per month for senior or executive track roles, depending on exchange rate and final agreement.



Bonuses may be paid weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly. Strong performers may earn bonuses that equal or exceed their base salary. For key contributors, senior developers, lead developers, and founding technical tea
mbers, additional project based bonuses, revenue share opportunities, or long term incentive opportunities may be available after a probationary and performance review period.



Nothing is automatic or guaranteed. Compensation depends on honesty, skill, speed, performance, reliability, project value, and contribution.



Positions may include

This is for highly experienced developers who can lead projects, review architecture, manage technical decisions, review other developers’ work, build complex systems, and potentially move into senior or executive level technology leadership.

We are not against AI. We use AI heavily and have access to many advanced AI tools, coding tools, APIs, and research systems.



You may use AI to help with debugging, analysis, documentation, research, planning, code review, and efficiency.



However, you cannot use AI as a substitute for knowing what you are doing. If you are hired as a developer, you must understand the code, structure, security, database logic, permissions, workflows, and systems you are working on.



Do not apply as a developer if your only ability is asking ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Kimi, Gemini, Codex, or another AI tool to build everything for you.



AI should help you move faster. It should not be the only reason you can do the work.



Some of the systems we are building may involve sensitive data, financial technology, business intelligence, user accounts, APIs, integrations, and security sensitive infrastructure. Poor code, weak database logic, bad permissions, bad security, or blindly copied AI code can create serious risk.



We need people who can check, recheck, debug, test, and think. AI can assist, but human judgment and technical skill are required.



Portfolio and proof of work



A GitHub profile, portfolio, live websites, app links, screenshots, code samples, or past project examples are highly encouraged.



But be honest. Tell us what you personally built, what you helped with, what was built by a team, and whether AI assisted you.



If AI assisted you, that is not automatically bad. What matters is honesty.



Do not waste time submitting fake portfolio work, AI generated demos, copied templates, or projects you did not truly build. If you only edited part of a project, say that. If you were part of a team, say what part you personally handled.



Portfolios will be reviewed closely before interviews. We may check originality, code structure, UI quality, console behavior, technical patterns, design quality, and whether your skill claims match the submitted work.



If you do not have a strong portfolio, that is okay. You can still apply. We will use custom testing to measure your real skill level.



Testing process



Every shortlisted applicant may be given a custom test.



The test will be based on what you claim in your application. If you claim WordPress skills, we test WordPress. If you claim React/Next.js skills, we test that. If you claim backend/API skills, we test backend/API skills. If you claim senior level architecture skills, the test will be much more advanced.



Tests may take:



15 to 30 minutes for basic roles

30 to 60 minutes for junior/mid roles

Several hours for senior roles

Potentially longer for executive track technology roles



Be honest in your application. The test is designed to confirm your actual level so we can offer a fair compensation package and avoid wasting anyone’s time.



Interview process



We move fast.



If your application looks strong, you may hear back the same day. Sometimes you may hear back within an hour. Depending on volume, it may take 1 to 2 days.



The interview will usually be short, around 10 to 15 minutes by phone, Zoom, or Google Meet. We do not believe in wasting time with many long interviews.



If you pass the screening, test, and interview, we may give you a final test or trial task, then present a compensation offer.



If you accept, you will sign the required agreements, receive your assigned access/corporate
 if needed, and start quickly.



Schedule



We are flexible.



You can apply if you want:



Part time

Full time

Flexible hours

Weekend only work

A few hours per week

40 to 50+ hours per week

Project based work

A senior dedicated role



If you only have 5 to 10 hours per week but you have a skill we need, apply.



If you want a serious full time role and can dedicate yourself to our projects, apply.



For senior lead and executive track roles, we prefer people who can be highly dedicated and not spread across many other client projects.



For entry, junior, mid level, or specialist roles, we can be flexible if you are honest about your availability.



Time tracking



OnlineJobs.ph TimeProof is required while working. Other third party time tracking or work verification tools may also be used later depending on the role.



Payment and contractor setup



You will initially be hired as an independent contractor for a U.S. based company.



Payment schedule can be weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly depending on our agreement.



Payment options may include:



GCash

Maya



Direct bank transfer

Payoneer

Wise



You are responsible for your own taxes, BIR, benefits, and local obligations as an independent contractor.



Future company structure



This is currently remote work for a U.S. based company. However, there may be future opportunities connected to a Philippine BPO or technology company structure headquartered in BGC / Bonifacio Global City as the company expands.



Our company is based out of Northern California, with U.S. corporate and technology headquarters there. Joshua David spends a significant amount of time in Bonifacio Global City, Metro Manila, and travels between Northern California and the Philippines as needed.



Several members of our senior operations and executive team are Filipino and Tagalog speaking, so applicants should understand that this is not a company that is unfamiliar with the Philippines, Filipino workers, or Filipino culture.



NDA / confidentiality



If hired, you must sign a non-disclosure agreement before receiving internal project details, code access, system access, data, or proprietary plans.



Some roles may require additional confidentiality, IP assignment, non-compete, or contract terms depending on the position.



Who should apply



Apply if you are honest, skilled, reliable, and serious about building real technology.



Apply if you want to grow.



Apply if you are tired of boring work and want to be part of something bigger.



Apply if you have only one strong skill and can be honest about it.



Apply if you are senior level and want a serious opportunity to help build multiple technology platforms.



Apply if you want a company where strong performance can be rewarded quickly, not just once per year.



Do not apply if you exaggerate your skill level, disappear, copy/paste AI work blindly, submit fake work, or cannot communicate clearly.



About us



Dosh Technology Group, Inc. and affiliated companies are U.S. based technology and financial technology companies building business, personal finance, credit, data, automation, software, and intelligence platforms.



Joshua David is the Managing Director and co-founder. He is based out of Northern California, where the company’s U.S. corporate and technology headquarters are located, and spends a significant amount of time in BGC / Bonifacio Global City, Metro Manila. He has lived in the Philippines for over 20 years and travels between Northern California and the Philippines.



He will be directly involved in hiring, training, reviewing work, assigning projects, and approving pay.



We prefer applicants based in Metro Manila or Luzon when possible, but this is not required. Skill, honesty, reliability, communication, and execution matter most.



How to apply



Click the apply button on OnlineJobs.ph and follow the application steps.



Please start your application message with your number one strongest skill set or role category.



Examples:



WordPress

Front-End UI

Full-Stack Developer

Backend API Developer

Database Developer

Cloudflare Server Engineer

Mobile App Developer

AI Automation Developer

Senior Lead Developer

VP / CTO Track



Then answer these 3 questions clearly:



1. Which role or skill category best fits you?



Example: WordPress, front-end/UI, full-stack, backend/API/database, Cloudflare/server/security, mobile/PWA/APK, AI automation/data ingestion, senior lead developer, VP/CTO track, or other.



2. Briefly explain your real experience and strongest skills.



Please include the tools, languages, frameworks, platforms, or systems you have actually worked with. Be clear about what you personally know, what you have personally built, what you are still learning, and what you can realistically bring to the table.



3. Send any proof of work if available.



This can include GitHub, portfolio links, live websites/apps, screenshots, code samples, project examples, or anything else that helps us understand your real skill level. If you do not have a strong portfolio, that is okay. Just explain your experience honestly.



Important note about portfolios, resumes, GitHub, screenshots, and proof of work



Please do not waste your time or our time by submitting fake portfolio work, copied projects, AI generated demos, polished resumes that do not match your real skill level, or websites/apps/code that you did not actually build.



It is okay if AI assisted you. It is okay if you worked as part of a team. It is okay if you only built part of a project. What matters is that you are honest about what you personally did.



Our internal screening process may review your application, resume, GitHub, portfolio links, live websites, screenshots, code samples, UI structure, code structure, page behavior, console patterns, image layers, OCR readable text, similarity patterns, and other technical signals.



Applications and portfolios may be reviewed through Dosh Technology Systems proprietary logic screening, AI assisted analysis, plagiarism detection, code similarity review, portfolio authenticity checks, and multiple internal review models.



If you try to submit work that is not original, not yours, heavily copied, fully AI generated, or made to deceive potential employers, assume that it will be flagged during screening.



That may work with other employers, but please do not assume it will work with us.



Again, honesty and transparency are the best policy. If you do not have a portfolio, just say that. If you are new but willing to learn, say that. If you are strong in one area but weak in another, say that. We are hiring across many skill levels, and the goal is to match the right person to the right role and fair compensation package.



What happens after you apply



We are reviewing applicants quickly and may respond the same day, sometimes within an hour, depending on volume.



If your application looks like a possible fit, you may be sent a formal application link where you will answer more detailed questions about your experience, skills, availability, expected pay, portfolio, and preferred role.



Based on those answers, you may be invited to complete a first skills test. This test will be based on what you told us you can do. For example, if you say you know WordPress, you may receive a WordPress related test. If you say you know backend/API/database work, your test may be related to that. If you apply for a senior or executive track role, the test may be more advanced.



If you pass the first screening and test, you may be invited to a short phone, Zoom, or Google Meet interview with Joshua David or one of the founders. The interview is usually expected to be around 10 to 15 minutes. It is mainly to meet you, understand your background, put a face with the name, and see if there is a good fit.



If both sides want to continue after the interview, you may receive one final custom test based on the role and compensation level being considered.



If you pass the final step, you may receive a formal offer with your starting compensation package. If accepted, you will sign the required NDA/confidentiality agreement, receive any assigned company access or corporate
 needed, and may be able to start as soon as within 24 to 48 hours depending on your availability.



Please be honest in your application. We are hiring across many skill levels, from basic WordPress support all the way to senior technology leadership. It is better to clearly explain your real current skill level than to overstate your experience.



Final message from Joshua David



Hi fellow Pinoys,



Before you apply, I want to personally say thank you for taking the time to read this full job post.



Even though I am American, I have lived in the Philippines for over 20 years and spent most of my adult life connected to the country. Much of that time was in the Visayas / Cebu area. I am based out of Northern California, where our U.S. corporate and technology headquarters are located, but I spend a significant amount of time in Bonifacio Global City, Metro Manila, and travel between Northern California and the Philippines.



The Philippines is not just a place I visit. It is part of my life, my family, and my story. I have 5 Fil-Am children, so Filipino culture, Filipino family values, and the Filipino way of life are very personal to me.



If you make it to an interview with me, please do not be nervous. I promise I will not give you a nosebleed. Haha. The interview will not be some long, high-pressure corporate interrogation. It will usually be quick, respectful, and direct. I want to understand who you are, what you can do, and whether we can build something together.



I do not like how many companies waste applicants’ time with too many unnecessary steps, repeated interviews, and slow decision-making. If you are a good fit, we can move fast. You may hear back within a few hours, possibly be hired within 24 to 72 hours, and potentially start onboarding or working by next week.



If you are honest with me, work hard, communicate clearly, and give real effort, I will treat you like part of the team and business family, not like just a number on a payroll sheet.



Aabangan ko ang ating pag-uusap at ang posibilidad na ika’y maging parte ng aming pamilya. Maraming salamat sa oras mo.



Good luck, and I look forward to reading your application soon.

mber in this role would be a strong candidate to grow into a Full-Time Financial Operations Manager with expanded responsibilities involving business reporting, financial analytics, process improvement, AI-assisted operational workflows, and business intelligence reporting.

title: Supply Chain & Inventory Manager
description:
About the Role



Ranch Winery & Brewery is looking for a Supply Chain & Inventory Manager to own the full flow of product across our winery, brewery, and distribution business. This is an end-to-end role covering forecasting, inventory planning, purchasing, supplier relationships, and logistics for both our in-house brews and our 3rd-party brewing partners. You'll be the person who makes sure our tasting rooms and the retail stores we supply across Texas are always properly stocked and every shipment lands on time.



What You'll Do

Forecast demand across wine, in-house brews, and 3rd-party brewed product to keep inventory aligned with sales and event calendars

Own inventory planning and replenishment for all Fredericksburg locations, production, and statewide retail distribution accounts

Manage purchasing and procurement, from raw materials and packaging to finished goods from co-pack and 3rd-party brewing partners

Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers, brewing partners, and logistics providers, negotiating terms and resolving issues

Coordinate inbound and outbound logistics, ensuring on-time delivery to retail partners across Texas and on-time receipt of supplies

Monitor stock levels across all locations to prevent stockouts and overstock, and manage transfers between sites as needed

Track key metrics (fill rate, on-time delivery, inventory turns) and report on supply chain performance

Partner with sales, production, and tasting room teams to align supply with growth and seasonal demand

Identify and implement process improvements across planning, purchasing, and distribution



What You Bring

3+ years of experience in supply chain, inventory management, purchasing, or logistics, ideally in beverage, food, or CPG distribution

Track record of managing end-to-end supply chain functions, not just one piece of the puzzle

Experience working with 3rd-party manufacturers/co-packers and managing supplier relationships

Strong forecasting and inventory planning skills, with comfort in spreadsheets and inventory/ERP systems

Excellent organizational skills and the ability to juggle multiple suppliers, locations, and delivery schedules

Clear communicator who can work cross-functionally with production, sales, and retail partners

Comfortable in a fast-paced, hands-on environment where priorities shift with the season and events calendar



To apply: please answer the screening questions below: (We'll auto fail candidates who do not answer these questions)



Prescreening Questions



1) Do you have 3+ years of experience in supply chain, inventory management, purchasing, or logistics?

2) Have you personally handled inventory forecasting/planning or reorder decisions?

3) Have you personally managed purchasing and dealt directly with suppliers?

4) Have you worked with manufacturers, co-packers, third-party production partners, or similar suppliers?

5) Which best describes the products you’ve managed?

-Food / beverage

-CPG / consumer goods

-Manufacturing / physical products

-E-commerce / retail physical products

-Other physical products

-Mostly services / non-physical products

6) Are you comfortable working full-time during US Central Time hours?

title: Short-Form Product Video Editor (Flexible/Ongoing)
description:
I need a fast, reliable editor for daily short-form TikTok product videos. The raw footage is simple but needs to be edited in a way that keeps viewers watching. The workload varies day to day. 5-30 videos 5 days a week is the goal.



What you'll be editing:



Short product videos up to 60 seconds. Content covers beauty, skincare, health, supplements, and food. I send raw clips in batches and expect finished videos ready by the next morning US Central Time. You can work whatever hours you want as long as deliverables are ready when I wake up.



Two types of content:



Talking head — I'm on camera speaking about the product. You'll receive a single video file to work with.

Voiceover — You'll receive a voiceover audio file and a set of product clips. You select and arrange the right clips to match the voiceover.



Editing tasks:



Trim clips and cut dead space

Combine multiple clips into one video

Zoom in and zoom out edits on nearly every clip to keep pacing tight and hold attention — this is not optional, it's the core of what makes these videos work

Speed up footage where needed to keep energy high

Apply retouch filters

Increase and adjust audio volume

Additional engaging edits as needed (subtle transitions, repositioning) to make simple takes feel dynamic

For voiceover videos, select appropriate product clips and arrange them to match the voiceover audio



You will not be adding on-screen text, captions, or music. Just clean, engaging cuts.



Volume and schedule:



Anywhere from 5 to 30 videos on a given day

Batches sent on weekdays only — no Saturdays or Sundays

This is ongoing work, not a one-off project, but the volume fluctuates



Requirements:



You must be fluent in English — speaking and understanding. We will communicate in English daily and you need to understand product context and voiceover content to edit effectively.

Fast turnaround

Attention to detail

Ability to follow examples and replicate a style



Software:



Use whatever you're fastest in — CapCut, Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci, doesn't matter.



Pay:



Negotiable based on your experience and skill level. Include your expected rate when you apply.



To apply, send:



2–3 examples of short-form videos you've edited (TikTok, Reels, or Shorts style). Label one of your example videos with your favorite animal.

Your realistic turnaround time for a batch of 20 videos

Your hourly rate expectation.

title: Creative Producer
description:
Creative Producer (AI Video and UGC) 



Who We Are (
c)


c is the parent company of a portfolio of technology businesses, including Mode Mobile, the creator of EarnOS, a transformational software platform that turns ordinary smartphones into "EarnPhones". This innovation empowers users worldwide to monetize everyday mobile activities such as streaming, gaming, and shopping. We enable users to profit from their data and attention, rather than letting only tech giants benefit. What sets us apart is our inclusive approach, converting users into earners, facilitating over $150M in earnings and savings, and going a step further by turning earners into owners by awarding stock ownership in 
c based on their usage. We have attracted over 40 million users across 170 countries.



Mode Mobile, Inc. Ranked Number 1 Fastest Growing Company in North America on the 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500.

For additional insights, check out information about our reward-based super app, Mode Earn App, which also powers the reward engine for our proprietary smartphone, Mode Earn Phone.



Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hardworking but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree but commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success.



The Role

We're looking for a Creative Producer to build the paid ads that scale a fast growing portfolio of consumer apps spanning rewarded/earn, utility, and viral/social categories. You'll take concepts and briefs from our Creative Strategists and turn them into finished, testable ads for Meta, TikTok, AppLovin, and Google: AI UGC, AI spokesperson video, app demo footage, and static variations.

This is a hands-on production role. You are in the edit every day, you ship volume, and AI is already part of how you work rather than something you are experimenting with. You'll also direct and QA output from our freelance editor and contractor network so the pipeline produces more than one person could alone.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Growth & UA, with day to day creative direction from our Ad Creative Lead. It will begin as a part-time, hourly position, averaging 20–35 hours per week, with the potential to transition to full-time.



Who You Are and What You'll Do

Produce high converting, AI powered paid ads for our consumer app portfolio across Meta, TikTok, AppLovin, and Google

Research competitor app ads, app store reviews, and winning advertising angles before producing new concepts, so every build starts from evidence rather than taste

Turn strategist briefs into finished ads (AI UGC, AI spokesperson video, app demo cuts, and static variations) without needing the brief explained twice

Refine AI generated output for character consistency, accuracy of the app shown on screen, environments, camera movement, and overall realism

Build app demo footage that reads on a phone: screen recordings, handheld shots of the app in use, and zooms or callouts that make the product moment obvious in the first two seconds and legible with the sound off

Edit for performance: hooks, pacing, captions, product storytelling, and a clear call to action

Ship at volume: 4-5 net new concepts per week with 4 to 5 variations each, cut to the aspect ratios and placement specs each network requires

Work directly with our Creative Strategists and UA Managers to see how your ads actually performed, then iterate on the patterns that win

Use AI creative tools to accelerate production, and help define the workflows that let the team punch above its headcount



What You Bring to the Team:



3+ years producing paid advertising creative for consumer apps, or for direct response brands with real app install work in your portfolio

Hundreds, and ideally thousands, of paid advertising creatives produced over the course of your career

A career primarily focused on Meta app install ads, TikTok ads, in app network creative such as AppLovin or Unity, AI UGC ads, and direct response advertising, not general video editing

Strong grasp of what makes an app ad convert: hooks, pacing, messaging, in app demonstration, legibility with the sound off, and creative testing



Expert in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Figma



AI native. Higgsfield, Runway, Veo, Kling, Pika, HeyGen, ChatGPT, Claude, or comparable platforms are already part of your daily production workflow, not something you are currently learning

Data informed. Comfortable using performance data (IPM, hook rate, hold rate, CPI/CPA, D1 and D7 retention) to decide what to build next, even without owning the analytics directly

Experience producing app store listing assets such as screenshots, feature graphics, and store preview videos that match the ad a user just clicked

Experience working in fast paced creative environments where new concepts and iterations are produced daily

Strong English communication, written and verbal. You can read a brief, ask the one question that matters, and deliver



Personal Attributes



Creative: A visionary thinker with the ability to develop innovative ideas that align with business goals and resonate with the target audience.

Efficient: Ability to work strategically and efficiently, optimizing resources to deliver high quality work within tight deadlines.

Adaptable: Comfortable working in a fast paced, remote, and iterative environment.

Analytical: Passion for turning data into insight and insight into growth.

Collaborative: Energized by working with creative, product, and data teams.

Alignment with our core Values:

Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement.

Action driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done.

Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment.

Curious: You focus on the 'why,' learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You're a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve.

Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance.



This role requires deep production craft and the discipline to ship at volume without letting quality slip, so we can keep pace with a fast growing, verticalized app portfolio.



If we just described you and your perfect role, we'd love to talk with you. We have a lot to accomplish this year and look forward to making headway and creating success together!

title: Part-Time Video Editor / Media VA (YouTube) — Long-Term, Growth to Full-Time

description:
ABOUT US

18 Wheeler Media LLC is a small, growing media company built by a solo founder — a full-time long-haul truck driver who produces the "Trucker Nightmares" YouTube channel and three sister brands from the road. Our stories are anthology-style: true-crime energy, mysteries, folklore, and dramatized fiction built on authentic trucking life. AI drafts fast; what we need is the human story editor who makes scripts WORTH LISTENING TO — structure, tension, voice, and the discipline to label fact vs. dramatization correctly every single time.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO

- Take story briefs and AI-assisted drafts and edit them into tight, narrated scripts (8-beat structure, cold-open hook, escalation, payoff) in the founder's voice — he records every final script himself in the truck

- Punch up hooks, kill dead air on the page, keep 10–15 minute scripts moving

- Fact-hygiene: separate what's sourced from what's dramatized; flag any line that states an unverified claim as fact, and NEVER let a real, identifiable person be accused of anything a source can't support — this is a hard company rule

- Label dramatization/reconstruction/composite clearly in the script per our standards

- Adapt one master story into variant framings for our sister brands

- Deliver clean, formatted scripts with time estimates, reading directions, and a source list



MUST-HAVES

- Proven scriptwriting or story-editing for YouTube narration, podcasts, true crime, horror, or documentary — link scripts or produced videos you shaped

- You understand spoken-word writing: rhythm, breath, short sentences, tension

- Strong research hygiene: you can tell a sourced fact from a rumor and you care

- Excellent English; American idiom fluency (our narrator is a US trucker)

- Comfortable editing AI-generated drafts hard — rewriting, not rubber-stamping

- Async-reliable; flags problems early instead of going quiet



NICE-TO-HAVES

- True crime / mystery / horror genre background

- Familiarity with YouTube retention (why viewers stay or leave a story)

- Any trucking, logistics, or blue-collar work familiarity — authenticity matters here



HOURS & COMMUNICATION

- Part-time to start (15–25 hrs/week), room to grow toward full-time

- Async-friendly by design: the founder drives a truck for a living. Written briefs in, edited scripts and written notes out. Weekly written check-in.



PAY

PHP 30,000–50,000/month depending on hours and demonstrated skill. There is a paid trial task before hire — a real story brief, paid whether or not you're hired.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word LOGBOOK as the first word of your message. Applications that skip this will not be reviewed — it's how we know you read the post.

2. Link 2–3 scripts you wrote or edited (or videos produced from your scripts). Tell us which parts were yours.

3. Answer these two questions:

- Take any famous story everyone knows. In 3–4 sentences, write the cold-open hook you'd use for a narrated YouTube version. Show us, don't describe.

- A draft you're editing states something damning about a named, real person, but the source is one Reddit post. What exactly do you do with that line?

title: PHOTOSHOP ECOMMERCE WEEKLY SALE
description:
PHOTOSHOP ECOMMERCE WEEKLY SALE**



This is a recurring weekly design gig involving pre-existing sales (such as Christmas) where you copy and paste pre-made product stacks and assets from master files into a sale template. Each sale features roughly 25–40 offers.



KEY DETAILS



- Difficulty / Stress: Low — simple execution, doesn't require heavy brain power, just time and quality.

- Estimate: 5–12 hours per week.

- Tools & Access: Adobe Photoshop (PSB multi-artboard files) and Dropbox. (Active Adobe account required — I can cover the cost.)

- Requirements:

  - Well-experienced in Photoshop

  - Powerful enough computer to handle large multi-artboard files (typically 70–120 artboards per file, unless split for performance)

  - Fluent English

- Support: I'll be online and actively reachable for your first few sales.



THE HARD RULES



- Deadline (AEST/AEDT): Everything 100% finished and locked in by Sunday ~9:00 AM for my review. Zero flexibility — though you manage your own hours during the week.

- Absences: A few days' notice required if you can't handle a sale week.



STEPS TO MAKE IT HAPPEN



1. DOWNLOAD THE TEMPLATE

- Grab the sale template from Dropbox or your brief link.



2. BUILD THE OFFERS LIST

- Review the offer checklist, search Dropbox for the exported file, and locate its source master PSB.

- Missing offers: If one doesn't exist, build it from scratch using products from 
 (or I'll handle occasional ones).

- Copy and paste the logo, product(s), and title into the new design.

- Formatting rules: Keep bonus item wording identical to previous weeks. Title text size must never exceed 85.

- Sizing: Typically 2 sizes per offer (3 for free-item offers). Work systematically down the list.



3. UPDATE THE HERO SECTION

- Add selected products, position the mascot so it appears to hold a product, and balance product colors diagonally across opposite corners (e.g., black bottom-left, black top-right) for a clean, premium look.

- Update the disclaimer text to match the brief's end of sale date



4. REVIEW & UPLOAD

- Export a single preview image of the full sale (resized under 5000px wide) plus hero files, ready for review by Sunday ~9:00 AM.

- Once approved, upload the PSD and final assets to the designated Dropbox folder (e.g., Christmas Sale > 2026 > Offers).

title: Senior Executive Assistant to Founder | Operations & Personal Brand
description:

I am a real estate entrepreneur, investor, capital raiser, and founder involved in several growing businesses. I manage multiple teams and projects, communicate with investors, travel frequently, and maintain an active personal brand.



I am looking for an experienced Executive Assistant who can become my trusted right hand.



Your primary responsibility will be to protect my time and drive follow-through. You will organize priorities, manage communication, coordinate projects, support investor relationships, and help nurture my personal brand.



This is not a basic virtual assistant role. I need someone who can think independently, anticipate needs, create structure, and take ownership without waiting for constant instructions.



Core Responsibilities

1. Executive Support and Time Management

• Manage and organize my
 inbox

• Identify urgent, important, and delegable messages

• Draft
 responses in my voice

• Manage and protect my calendar

• Schedule meetings across multiple businesses and time zones

• Prevent scheduling conflicts and overloaded days

• Prepare agendas, meeting notes, and background information

• Track decisions, commitments, and follow-up items

• Coordinate business travel, appointments, and occasional personal logistics

• Help determine what requires my attention and what can be delegated



2. Business Operations and Follow-Through

• Maintain a clear master list of projects, priorities, deadlines, and owners

• Turn meetings,
s, voice notes, and ideas into organized action items

• Follow up with employees, partners, vendors, and contractors

• Identify overdue or at-risk tasks before I have to ask

• Prepare weekly priority and accountability updates

• Support recurring leadership meetings

• Create and maintain standard operating procedures

• Keep Google Drive, Notion, and other systems organized

• Assist with recruiting, onboarding, research, and special projects

• Identify operational gaps and recommend practical solutions



3. Investor and Capital-Raising Support

• Schedule and prepare for investor and strategic relationship calls

• Maintain accurate investor and prospect records

• Track conversations, introductions, follow-ups, and next steps

• Coordinate investor communications, private briefings, webinars, and events

• Organize approved investment materials and documents

• Assist with investor onboarding and administrative requests

• Coordinate with legal, accounting, operations, and marketing tea
mbers

• Track relationship activity and ensure important contacts are consistently nurtured

Compliance note: Accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance are essential. You may not independently provide investment advice, promise returns, change investment claims, or distribute unapproved offering information.



4. LinkedIn, Media and Personal Brand Management

You will help manage and nurture my personal brand as a real estate entrepreneur, operator, investor, and capital raiser.

This is not simply posting on social media. The goal is to consistently communicate my experience, perspective, operating credibility, leadership, and personality.

• Own and maintain my content and media calendar

• Manage the execution of my LinkedIn strategy

• Ensure at least two substantive LinkedIn posts are developed and published each week

• Develop content around operating results, market insights, underwriting discipline, leadership, partnerships, and active real estate operations

• Interview me and review meetings, voice notes, travel, deals, property visits, and business activities for content opportunities

• Draft LinkedIn posts, captions, newsletters,
s, and short-form content in my voice

• Coordinate Instagram and
 content that supports my broader personal brand

• Balance business content with appropriate personal topics such as entrepreneurship, family, travel, fitness, and leadership

• Organize photos, videos, drafts, voice notes, testimonials, and media assets

• Coordinate with designers, video editors, photographers, and other marketing support

• Repurpose approved content across platforms

• Review content for quality, accuracy, tone, and brand alignment

• Track content from idea through drafting, approval, production, and publication

• Monitor meaningful comments, messages, mentions, and engagement

• Flag engagement from investors, family offices, strategic partners, and other important relationships

• Research podcasts, conferences, speaking opportunities, awards, media opportunities, and strategic partnerships

• Assist with outreach, applications, scheduling, biographies, talking points, and preparation

• Review content performance and recommend improvements based on business goals, not vanity metrics



You do not need to be a professional graphic designer or advanced video editor. You do need strong marketing judgment, excellent writing skills, and the ability to keep the process moving.



Required Experience

• At least four years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Senior Virtual Assistant, Operations Assistant, or similar role

• Experience directly supporting a founder, CEO, entrepreneur, or senior executive

• Experience working with a U.S.-based company or executive

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Strong inbox, calendar, task-management, and follow-up skills

• Ability to manage multiple projects and changing priorities

• Strong judgment, organization, and attention to detail

• Confidence communicating with executives, investors, employees, and vendors

• Ability to work independently and make reasonable decisions

• Experience drafting executive, LinkedIn, or personal-brand content

• Ability to learn and write in someone else's voice

• Reliable availability during Central Time business hours

• Dependable computer, high-speed internet, and backup plans for internet or power interruptions



Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following is strongly preferred:

• Real estate, investments, asset management, or financial services

• Investor relations or CRM management

• LinkedIn thought leadership or executive personal-brand management

• Podcast, conference, or speaking-opportunity outreach

• Recruiting and employee onboarding

• Travel planning and event coordination

• Creating SOPs and improving business processes

• Using AI tools to improve productivity



Technology: We regularly use Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Notion, Slack, Canva, Zoom, CRM platforms, social media tools, and ChatGPT. You do not need to know every platform, but you must learn technology quickly.



You Will Thrive in This Role If You

• Naturally notice what is missing

• Follow through without repeated reminders

• Ask thoughtful questions instead of making careless assumptions

• Can separate what is important from what is simply noisy

• Communicate clearly and directly

• Are comfortable respectfully pushing for decisions

• Can accept feedback without becoming defensive

• Understand that confidentiality and discretion are non-negotiable

• Enjoy creating order around a fast-moving entrepreneur

• Want a long-term role with room to grow



This role is not a good fit for someone who needs detailed instructions for every task, avoids difficult follow-up, or waits silently when something is unclear.



What Success Looks Like Within your first 90 days:

• My inbox and calendar are organized and under control

• Meetings are prepared for and followed up on

• Projects, deadlines, and commitments are tracked in one reliable system

• Tea
mbers know what they own and when it is due

• Investor and strategic relationship follow-up is accurate and timely

• Two strong LinkedIn posts are consistently published each week

• Business and personal content is planned several weeks ahead

• Relevant activities are regularly identified and converted into content

• Media, podcast, conference, and speaking opportunities are actively tracked

• Problems are surfaced before they become emergencies

• I spend less time tracking people and more time leading and growing the businesses



THE GOAL IS SIMPLE: Fewer dropped balls, less mental load, stronger execution, and more of my time focused on the work



How to Apply:

Begin the first line of your application with: RIGHT HAND



Please submit the following in your application:

1. Your resume or OnlineJobs.ph profile

2. A 60 to 90-second video introducing yourself and explaining why you are qualified

3. An example of a problem you solved before your executive asked

4. An example of how you managed competing priorities

5. Two examples of LinkedIn or executive content you have written or managed

6. The software platforms you have used regularly

7. Your desired monthly salary in U.S. dollars

8. Your Central Time availability and earliest possible start date

9. Details about your computer, internet speed, and backup plans

10. A brief explanation of how you would turn a founder's voice note about walking away from a real estate deal into useful business content

Please do not submit a generic application. Strong judgment, careful reading, and clear communication are essential to this position.

This is intended to be a stable, long-term role with opportunities to take on greater responsibility as trust is established and the businesses continue to grow.

title: Experienced U.S. Solar Closer — Verified Closing Results Required

Prosper is recruiting an experienced remote closer for U.S. homeowner solar and home-energy opportunities. You must be able to take a qualified, held sales conversation through discovery, presentation, objection handling, a clear decision, accurate documentation, and a clean internal handoff.



This is not an entry-level sales, appointment-setting, cold-calling, lead-generation, customer-service, or virtual-assistant position. Applicants must prove that they personally conducted full sales presentations and closed real customers.

• No hourly wage or base salary is promised

Advancement depends on verified results, ethical sales quality, customer retention, leadership ability, and business need.



Evidence-qualified applicants must be available for a live group interview on Tuesday, August 11, 2026 at 2:00 PM Eastern Time (New York time). A smaller role-specific closer evaluation follows.



WHAT YOU MUST BE ABLE TO OWN

• Establish trust quickly with U.S. homeowners by phone or video

• Run complete discovery around goals, usage, concerns, timing, and decision process

• Present the approved solution accurately without inventing savings, incentives, timelines, or guarantees

• Handle price, timing, trust, spouse or co-decision-maker, comparison-shopping, and “I need to think about it” objections ethically

• Ask directly for a decision when the opportunity is qualified

• Complete accurate CRM notes, documents, and internal handoffs

• Follow up professionally and protect cancellation quality

• Report held presentations, closes, close rate, cancellations, and retained results honestly



MINIMUM EXPERIENCE



• At least three recent years in full-cycle phone, video, or consultative closing

• Direct experience closing U.S. consumers

• U.S. solar, roofing, HVAC, insurance, real estate, telecommunications, financing, or home-improvement experience is strongly preferred

• A measurable record of held presentations, closed sales, gross close rate, retained close rate, average deal value, and cancellations

• Experience using a CRM and a structured sales process

• Clear spoken and written English suitable for high-trust homeowner decisions

• Reliable computer, high-speed internet, professional headset and camera, quiet workspace, and dependable Eastern Time availability



DO NOT APPLY IF



• Your experience ends with setting appointments, cold calling, transferring calls, or reading a script

• You cannot separate booked appointments from held presentations and closed sales

• You cannot provide redacted evidence supporting your recent results

• You use vague claims such as “top performer,” “high ticket,” or “great closer” without numbers

• You need basic discovery, objection-handling, or closing training

• You will not complete the required video and live role-play



HARD APPLICATION GATE



Your first line must be exactly:



My verified close rate was ___ percent across ___ held presentations during ________, and I can attend Tuesday, August 11 at 2:00 PM Eastern Time.



Then answer every question:



1. What product or service did you personally close?

2. Which U.S. markets or states did you serve?

3. During your most recent measured period, how many appointments were assigned, how many were held, and how many did you close?

4. What were your gross and retained close rates?

REQUIRED PROOF

• One professional reference who supervised or audited your production

REQUIRED VIDEO AUDITION — PROVE IT

The homeowner owns the home and pays approximately $250 per month for electricity. The homeowner wants to lower long-term energy costs but is skeptical because a friend said solar is a scam.
