title: Sales Development Representative (outbound calling)
description:
You've achieved great results in sales, appointment setting, or telemarketing. You're resilient, you don't take rejection personally, and you understand that the phone is your primary tool. You're comfortable with cold calling and know that every 'no' gets you closer to a 'yes'. But you're ready for a role where your effort is directly tied to your results.



You'll join Performia Australia, part of a global Swedish HR consultancy operating in 26 countries. Our mission is to train and support business owners so they know how to identify and build productive, safe and fun teams.



Your end goal is to fill the CEO's calendar with qualified appointments. You'll be proactively prospecting and calling a mix of warm leads, contacts from our database, and cold lists. Your job is to generate the activity that creates the pipeline. You'll qualify them, handle objections, and book them for a meeting with the CEO.



We have a strong lead database and we need you to take ownership of finding and creating opportunities. This means a significant portion of your time will be spent on cold calling and prospecting. The role will be high-volume and requires discipline and resilience.



The role will be challenging and demanding. You'll be expected to make a high volume of calls, face frequent rejection, and maintain a positive, professional attitude. You need to be able to work independently, manage your time effectively, and take full ownership of your results. This is not a role for someone who needs a warm lead handed to them.



In return, you'll be paid a base hourly rate plus a generous bonus for every qualified appointment that is kept. You'll have the opportunity to receive full training on the Performia methodology and sales process once proven your ability. You'll work from home with a flexible, cheerful, and outcome-focused team. There are significant growth opportunities for top performers.



If you are someone who cannot work independently, needs to be around people all the time, or cannot handle cold calling and rejection, then this role will not be right for you.



If you're driven and love the challenge of the hunt, apply now.

title: Brand & Growth Strategist (Organic Marketing)
description:
ABOUT US

Since 2014, Michael Blank has been one of the leading voices in multifamily real estate investing, helping thousands of investors build wealth through apartment syndications. Our mission is simple: educate, inspire, and build the next generation of Deal Makers.



The real estate market is shifting. Many brands are slowing down or disappearing. We're doing the opposite. We're investing heavily into organic marketing with the goal of becoming the undisputed authority in multifamily syndications while growing Deal Maker Mastermind into the #1 community for serious real estate entrepreneurs.



We're looking for someone who wants to build that with us.



THE OPPORTUNITY

This is not a Social Media Manager role. We're looking for someone who thinks like a marketer, strategist, business owner, and creative all at once.



Your job isn't to post content. Your job is to build an organic marketing engine that grows our authority, strengthens our brand, and consistently generates customers. 



You will own our organic content strategy from idea to execution, working directly with leadership every week to develop, execute, measure, and continuously improve our marketing.



If you love psychology, branding, storytelling, social media, AI, analytics, and figuring out why content performs (or doesn't), you'll probably love this role.



YOUR MISSION

Build Michael Blank into the leading authority in multifamily real estate syndications while growing Deal Maker Mastermind into the leading community in the industry.



Everything you create should support one or more of these goals:

• Build trust.

• Increase authority.

• Educate our audience.

• Entertain where appropriate.

• Generate qualified leads.

• Convert viewers into paying members.



We don't chase views. We build authority that drives revenue.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

You will have ownership over our entire organic marketing strategy.



Strategy

• Develop and own our organic content strategy.

• Create and maintain a structured content calendar.

• Identify content opportunities before anyone else does.

• Study competitors, trends, algorithms, and consumer behavior.

• Continuously improve our marketing systems.



Content

• Develop content ideas aligned with business goals.

• Write scripts for Michael Blank.

• Request any footage you need (talking head, B-roll, event footage, etc.).

• Repurpose podcasts, webinars, coaching calls, and our content library into platform-specific content.

• Edit long-form YouTube videos.

• Create short-form videos.

• Design supporting graphics in Canva.

• Write captions and marketing copy using AI.

• Optimize every asset before publishing.



Platform Growth

• Manage YouTube.

• Grow Instagram.

• Expand strategically into LinkedIn, TikTok,
, and other relevant platforms.

• Adapt content for each platform instead of simply reposting the same content everywhere.



Analytics & Optimization

• Track KPIs weekly and monthly.

• Set hypotheses and run experiments.

• A/B test hooks, thumbnails, captions, CTAs, and formats.

• Explain what worked, what didn't, and what we'll change next.

• Own performance instead of blaming algorithms.



Community

• Publish consistently.

• Respond to comments across platforms.

• Help build relationships with our audience.

• Turn engagement into community growth.



AI

AI is part of how we work. We're looking for someone who embraces AI to increase speed, quality, creativity, and output. You don't need to write every word from scratch, but you should know how to use AI to produce exceptional work while maintaining our voice and standards.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within your first year, success looks like:

• A consistent, documented content strategy.

• Two high-quality posts per day across our primary platforms.

• Platform-specific content rather than one-size-fits-all publishing.

• Michael Blank becoming the go-to authority in our niche.

• Deal Maker Mastermind consistently generating 4–8 new members per month from organic marketing.

• A repeatable content engine that produces measurable business results.

• Weekly reporting with clear KPIs, learnings, and next steps.



YOU MIGHT BE A GREAT FIT IF...

You:

• Think like an owner, not an employee.

• Love marketing, branding, psychology, and social media.

• Care more about revenue than vanity metrics.

• Have exceptional attention to detail.

• Understand what makes content convert.

• Enjoy both strategy and execution.

• Are proactive and bring solutions instead of waiting for instructions.

• Naturally analyze why content succeeds or fails.

• Are highly organized.

• Have excellent written English.

• Love learning and adapting.

• Get excited about building something that compounds over years.



TOOLS YOU'LL USE

• Claude Code + CoWork

• Premiere Pro

• Canva

• GoHighLevel



Most important: you love picking up new software and skills quickly — our tools may evolve, and you should be comfortable adapting.



REQUIRED SKILLS

• Excellent video editing skills.

• Strong understanding of YouTube and short-form content.

• Canva proficiency.

• Strong prompting and AI workflow skills.

• Understanding of marketing psychology and customer journeys.

• Ability to recognize and refine persuasive copy.

• Excellent organizational skills.

• Native-level or near-native English.

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.



SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION

This is a full-time role — 40 hours/week, with a flexible schedule. Some overlap with the team's working hours is expected for meetings and collaboration (roughly 2–4 hours/day).



We're results-driven, not time-driven — it's not required that you work an exact 9-5 as long as the work gets done and you deliver results. Some weeks may be lighter than 40 hours; others (launches, events, big campaigns) may require more.



Starting rate is $750/month during a 90-day probationary period, with increases as we confirm fit.

title: Dental Virtual Assistant
description:
We are established dental clinic in Melbourne, looking for an experienced Virtual Assistant to assist with patient recall, reactivation and treatment follow-up. 



This role is ideal for someone who has previous experience working remotely for an Australian dental practice or healthcare clinic, particularly with patient recalls and appointment booking. 



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

Your primary focus will be helping us reconnect with existing patients and encourage them to return to the clinic.



Your responsibilities will include:

- Contacting patients who are overdue for their 6-monthly dental check up and clean 

- Reactivating patients who have not attended the clinic for an extended period 

- Following up patients with outstanding or incomplete treatment plans 

- Calling, SMSing and/or
ing patients to help organise appointments

- Following up patients who may not respond to the first contact 

- Booking appointments directly into our appointment book where appropriate 

- Keeping accurate notes of conversations and follow-up attempts 

- Maintaining an organised follow up list so patients do not fall through the cracks 

- Providing regular updates on contacts made, appointments booked and follow-ups required



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR 

We are specifically looking for someone who:

- Has previous experience with dental patient recalls, reactivation or treatment follow up 

- Is confident speaking with patients over the phone 

- Has excellent spoken and written English 

- Has a warm, friendly and natural communication style 

- Understands how to encourage a patient to book without sounding overly sales-focused or pushy

- Is comfortable handling common patient objections such as being busy, cost concerns, wanting to think about treatment, or simply forgetting to book

- Is proactive and comfortable following up patients more than once when appropriate

- Is organised and reliable

- Can work independently and take ownership of the recall/reactivation list 

- Understands the importance of patient privacy and confidentiality 



Dental experience is highly preferred. Please let us know which dental practices, dental software or patient management systems you have previously worked with. 



PHONE CALLS 

We use a VoIP phone system, so ideally you will be comfortable accessing and making calls through our VoIP system remotely. 



Patients should feel as though they are speaking directly with a friendly member of our dental team.

  someone's backyard, patio, or home.

, Instagram, Google, Pinterest — whatever converts)

   fast

 Ads Manager experience

 with:
